name: Dandelin.l14_mem_cone_iff
statement:
theorem l14_mem_cone_iff {V u X : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
    (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) ↔ X ∈ cone V u (Real.cos α)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne X V with rfl | hX
  · simp only [true_or, true_iff]
    show ⟪X - X, u⟫ = Real.cos α * ‖X - X‖
    simp
  · rw [← mem_cone_iff_angle hu hα hX]; simp [hX]

name: Dandelin.l14_mem_cone2_iff
statement:
theorem l14_mem_cone2_iff {V u X : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
    (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) ↔
      X ∈ cone2 V u (Real.cos α)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne X V with rfl | hX
  · simp only [true_or, true_iff]
    show ⟪X - X, u⟫ ^ 2 = Real.cos α ^ 2 * ‖X - X‖ ^ 2
    simp
  · rw [← mem_cone2_iff_angle hu hα hX]; simp [hX]

name: Dandelin.l14_mem_plane_iff
statement:
theorem l14_mem_plane_iff {p₀ n X : E} :
    X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ↔ X ∈ plane p₀ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [plane_eq_mk', SetLike.mem_coe]

name: Dandelin.l14_isTangentAt_plane
statement:
theorem l14_isTangentAt_plane {p₀ n C F : E} {r : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (h : (⟨C, r⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ)) :
    F = C - ⟪C - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧ |⟪C - p₀, n⟫| = r
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : ⟪n, n⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn]; norm_num
  have hFπ : ⟪F - p₀, n⟫ = 0 := l14_mem_plane_iff.1 h.mem_space
  have hFS : ‖F - C‖ = r := by
    have := h.mem_sphere
    rwa [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] at this
  set w := (F - C) - ⟪F - C, n⟫ • n with hw
  have hwn : ⟪w, n⟫ = 0 := by
    rw [hw, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, hnn, mul_one, sub_self]
  have hx : F + w ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ := by
    rw [l14_mem_plane_iff]
    show ⟪F + w - p₀, n⟫ = 0
    rw [show F + w - p₀ = (F - p₀) + w by abel, inner_add_left, hFπ, hwn, add_zero]
  have hperp := h.le_orthRadius hx
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mem_orthRadius_iff_inner_left, vsub_eq_sub, vsub_eq_sub,
    show F + w - F = w by abel] at hperp
  have hww : ⟪w, w⟫ = 0 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hw]
    rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hwn, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact hperp
  have hw0 : w = 0 := inner_self_eq_zero.1 hww
  have hFC : ⟪F - C, n⟫ = -⟪C - p₀, n⟫ := by
    rw [show F - C = (F - p₀) - (C - p₀) by abel, inner_sub_left, hFπ, zero_sub]
  have e : F - C = ⟪F - C, n⟫ • n := by rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hw, hw0]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hFC, neg_smul] at e
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add'] at e
    rw [e, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  · rw [← hFS, e, norm_smul, hn, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hFC, abs_neg]

name: Dandelin.l14_isTangentAt_proj
statement:
theorem l14_isTangentAt_proj {p₀ n C : E} {r : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hr : |⟪C - p₀, n⟫| = r) :
    (⟨C, r⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt (C - ⟪C - p₀, n⟫ • n)
      (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ)
proof:
:= by
  have hF := proj_mem_plane (C := C) (p₀ := p₀) hn
  refine ⟨?_, l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hF, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · rw [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm]
    exact (tangent_of_proj hn rfl hr hF hF).1
  · rw [EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mem_orthRadius_iff_inner_left, vsub_eq_sub, vsub_eq_sub]
    exact (tangent_of_proj hn rfl hr (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hx) hF).2

name: Dandelin.l14_isTangent_plane_iff
statement:
theorem l14_isTangent_plane_iff {p₀ n C : E} {r : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) :
    (⟨C, r⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangent (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ↔
      |⟪C - p₀, n⟫| = r
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, h⟩ => (l14_isTangentAt_plane hn h).2, fun h => ⟨_, l14_isTangentAt_proj hn h⟩⟩

name: Dandelin.l14_proj_ne
statement:
theorem l14_proj_ne {V u n p₀ : E} {d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1) (hd : d₁ ≠ d₂) :
    (V + d₁ • u) - ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ≠ (V + d₂ • u) - ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have e : (d₁ - d₂) • (u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) = 0 := by
    have h' := sub_eq_zero.2 h
    rw [← h']
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, smul_sub, sub_smul,
      add_smul, mul_smul]
    abel
  rcases smul_eq_zero.1 e with h0 | h0
  · exact hd (sub_eq_zero.1 h0)
  · have hu' : u = ⟪u, n⟫ • n := sub_eq_zero.1 h0
    have : ‖u‖ = |⟪u, n⟫| := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hu']
      rw [norm_smul, hn, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [hu] at this
    nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫]

name: Dandelin.l14_cos_sin
statement:
theorem l14_cos_sin {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) :
    Real.cos α ^ 2 + Real.sin α ^ 2 = 1 ∧ 0 < Real.cos α ∧ 0 < Real.sin α ∧
      α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq α, Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith, hα1⟩,
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hα0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]), ⟨hα0.le, by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩⟩

name: Dandelin.l14_directrix_eq
statement:
theorem l14_directrix_eq {V u n p₀ : E} {b : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    directrix V u n p₀ b =
      ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ⊓ AffineSubspace.mk' (V + b • u) (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ :
        AffineSubspace ℝ E) : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  have huu : ⟪u, u⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]; norm_num
  ext X
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, AffineSubspace.mem_inf_iff, l14_mem_plane_iff, AffineSubspace.mem_mk', vsub_eq_sub,
    Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left]
  show X ∈ plane p₀ n ∧ ⟪X - V, u⟫ = b ↔ _
  rw [show X - (V + b • u) = (X - V) - b • u by abel]
  rw [inner_sub_left (X - V) (b • u), real_inner_smul_left, huu, mul_one, sub_eq_zero]

name: Dandelin.l14_dandelin_ellipse
statement:
theorem l14_dandelin_ellipse {V u n p₀ : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) (hm : Real.sin α < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧ 0 < L ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, (⟨V + d • u, d * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangent
          (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      (⟨V + d₁ • u, d₁ * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₁
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      (⟨V + d₂ • u, d₂ * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₂
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ * ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ < 0 ∧
      ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) ↔ dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hks, hk, hs, hαI⟩ := l14_cos_sin hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₁, hd, htan, hopp, -, -, hp₁, hp₂, hsec⟩ :=
    dandelin_exists hu hn hks hk hs hm hc
  refine ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, (d₂ - d₁) * Real.cos α, hd₁, hd, mul_pos (by linarith) hk,
    fun d => ?_, ?_, ?_, hopp, fun X hX => ?_⟩
  · rw [l14_isTangent_plane_iff hn]; exact htan d
  · rw [hp₁]; exact l14_isTangentAt_proj hn ((htan d₁).2 (Or.inl rfl))
  · rw [hp₂]; exact l14_isTangentAt_proj hn ((htan d₂).2 (Or.inr rfl))
  · rw [l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hsec X (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX)

name: Dandelin.l14_inscribed
statement:
theorem l14_inscribed {V u X : E} {α d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα0 : 0 < α)
    (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) (hd : 0 < d) (hX : X ≠ V) (hXα : angle (X - V) u = α) :
    (∃ T : E, (⟨V + d • u, d * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt T
      line[ℝ, V, X]) ∧ d * Real.sin α ≤ dist X (V + d • u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hks, hk, hs, hαI⟩ := l14_cos_sin hα0 hα1
  have hc : X ∈ cone V u (Real.cos α) := (l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI).1 (Or.inr hXα)
  have hn : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 hX)
  refine ⟨⟨_, isTangentAt_tangencyPoint hu hks (by positivity) hc hn⟩, ?_⟩
  have h := cone_outside_sphere (V := V) (u := u) (X := X) (d := d) hu hks hc
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  exact le_of_sq_le_sq (by simpa using h) (norm_nonneg _) |> fun h' => by
    simpa [abs_of_pos (mul_pos hd hs)] using h'

name: Dandelin.l14_mem_lower_iff
statement:
theorem l14_mem_lower_iff {V u X : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
    (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) ↔ X ∈ cone V (-u) (Real.cos α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← l14_mem_cone_iff (by rw [norm_neg, hu]) hα, angle_neg_right]
  constructor <;> rintro (h | h) <;> first | exact Or.inl h | exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: Dandelin.l14_sq_lt_one
statement: theorem l14_sq_lt_one {m s : ℝ} (hs1 : s < 1) (hm : |m| ≤ s) : m ^ 2 < 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ |m| := abs_nonneg m
  nlinarith [sq_abs m]

name: Dandelin.l14_dandelin_hyperbola
statement:
theorem l14_dandelin_hyperbola {V u n p₀ : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < Real.sin α)
    (hc : V ∉ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) :
    1 < Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α ∧
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, ∃ L : ℝ, d₂ < 0 ∧ 0 < d₁ ∧ 0 < L ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, (⟨V + d • u, |d| * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangent
          (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      (⟨V + d₁ • u, |d₁| * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₁
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      (⟨V + d₂ • u, |d₂| * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₂
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) →
        dist X F₂ - dist X F₁ = L) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) →
        dist X F₁ - dist X F₂ = L) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
        (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) ↔
          |dist X F₁ - dist X F₂| = L) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) ↔
          dist X F₁ = Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α * Metric.infDist X
            ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ⊓
              AffineSubspace.mk' (V + (d₁ * Real.cos α ^ 2) • u) (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ :
                AffineSubspace ℝ E) : Set E)) ∧
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) ↔
          dist X F₂ = Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α * Metric.infDist X
            ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ⊓
              AffineSubspace.mk' (V + (d₂ * Real.cos α ^ 2) • u) (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ :
                AffineSubspace ℝ E) : Set E)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hks, hk, hs, hαI⟩ := l14_cos_sin hα0 hα1
  have hc' : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hc; rw [l14_mem_plane_iff]
    show ⟪V - p₀, n⟫ = 0
    rw [show V - p₀ = -(p₀ - V) by abel, inner_neg_left, h, neg_zero]
  have hs1 : Real.sin α < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hm1 := l14_sq_lt_one hs1 hm.le
  obtain ⟨he, d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₂, hd₁, htan, -, -, hp₁, hp₂, hup, hlow, hiff, -⟩ :=
    dandelin_hyperbola hu hn hks hk hs hm hc'
  have ht₁ := (htan d₁).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have ht₂ := (htan d₂).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  refine ⟨he, d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α, hd₂, hd₁, mul_pos (by linarith) hk,
    fun d => ?_, ?_, ?_,
    fun X hX hXc => ?_, fun X hX hXc => ?_, fun X hX => ?_, fun X hX => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [l14_isTangent_plane_iff hn]; exact htan d
  · rw [hp₁]; exact l14_isTangentAt_proj hn ht₁
  · rw [hp₂]; exact l14_isTangentAt_proj hn ht₂
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hup X (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX) ((l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI).1 hXc)
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hlow X (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX) ((l14_mem_lower_iff hu hαI).1 hXc)
  · rw [l14_mem_cone2_iff hu hαI, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hiff X (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX)
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn hp₁ ht₁ (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX)
      (hp₁ ▸ proj_mem_plane hn)
    rw [l14_mem_cone2_iff hu hαI, dist_eq_norm, ← l14_directrix_eq hu]
    exact mem_cone2_iff_focal_directrix hu hn hks hk hm1 (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX) h1 h2
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn hp₂ ht₂ (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX)
      (hp₂ ▸ proj_mem_plane hn)
    rw [l14_mem_cone2_iff hu hαI, dist_eq_norm, ← l14_directrix_eq hu]
    exact mem_cone2_iff_focal_directrix hu hn hks hk hm1 (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX) h1 h2

name: Dandelin.l14_directrix_ellipse
statement:
theorem l14_directrix_ellipse {V u n p₀ : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) (hm : Real.sin α < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) (hm1 : |⟪u, n⟫| < 1) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α < 1 ∧
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧
      (⟨V + d₁ • u, d₁ * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₁
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      (⟨V + d₂ • u, d₂ * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₂
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) ↔
          dist X F₁ = Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α * Metric.infDist X
            ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ⊓
              AffineSubspace.mk' (V + (d₁ * Real.cos α ^ 2) • u) (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ :
                AffineSubspace ℝ E) : Set E)) ∧
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) ↔
          dist X F₂ = Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α * Metric.infDist X
            ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ⊓
              AffineSubspace.mk' (V + (d₂ * Real.cos α ^ 2) • u) (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ :
                AffineSubspace ℝ E) : Set E))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hks, hk, hs, hαI⟩ := l14_cos_sin hα0 hα1
  have hm1' : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫]
  have he := (ecc_lt_one_iff hks hk hs).2 hm
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₁, hd, htan, -, -, -, hp₁, hp₂, -⟩ :=
    dandelin_exists hu hn hks hk hs hm hc
  have ht₁ := (htan d₁).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have ht₂ := (htan d₂).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  refine ⟨he, d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₁, hd, ?_, ?_, fun X hX => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [hp₁]; exact l14_isTangentAt_proj hn ht₁
  · rw [hp₂]; exact l14_isTangentAt_proj hn ht₂
  · have hX' := l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn hp₁ ht₁ hX' (hp₁ ▸ proj_mem_plane hn)
    rw [l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI, dist_eq_norm, ← l14_directrix_eq hu]
    refine ⟨fun hXc => focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul hu hn hks hk hm1' hX' hXc h1 h2, fun h => ?_⟩
    exact directrix_converse_nappe hu hn hks hk hs hm.le hc hm1' hX'
      (by rw [abs_of_pos hd₁]; exact h1) h2 h
  · have hX' := l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn hp₂ ht₂ hX' (hp₂ ▸ proj_mem_plane hn)
    rw [l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI, dist_eq_norm, ← l14_directrix_eq hu]
    refine ⟨fun hXc => focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul hu hn hks hk hm1' hX' hXc h1 h2, fun h => ?_⟩
    exact directrix_converse_nappe hu hn hks hk hs hm.le hc hm1' hX'
      (by rw [abs_of_pos (hd₁.trans hd)]; exact h1) h2 h

name: Dandelin.l14_parabola
statement:
theorem l14_parabola {V u n p₀ : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| = Real.sin α)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α = 1 ∧
    ∃ d : ℝ, ∃ F : E, 0 < d ∧
      (∀ d' : ℝ, (⟨V + d' • u, d' * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangent
          (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ↔ d' = d) ∧
      (⟨V + d • u, d * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) ↔
          dist X F = Metric.infDist X
            ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ⊓
              AffineSubspace.mk' (V + (d * Real.cos α ^ 2) • u) (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ :
                AffineSubspace ℝ E) : Set E))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hks, hk, hs, hαI⟩ := l14_cos_sin hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨he, d, F, hd, htan, -, hFp, hdir⟩ := directrix_parabola hu hn hks hk hs hm.symm hc
  have hm1 : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1 := by rw [← sq_abs, hm]; nlinarith
  have ht := (htan d).2 rfl
  refine ⟨he, d, F, hd, fun d' => ?_, ?_, fun X hX => ?_⟩
  · rw [l14_isTangent_plane_iff hn]; exact htan d'
  · rw [hFp]; exact l14_isTangentAt_proj hn ht
  · have hX' := l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn hFp ht hX' (hFp ▸ proj_mem_plane hn)
    rw [l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI, dist_eq_norm, ← l14_directrix_eq hu]
    refine ⟨hdir X hX', fun h => ?_⟩
    rw [← one_mul (Metric.infDist _ _), ← he] at h
    exact directrix_converse_nappe hu hn hks hk hs hm.symm.le hc hm1 hX'
      (by rw [abs_of_pos hd]; exact h1) h2 h

name: Dandelin.l14_section_eq
statement:
theorem l14_section_eq {V u n p₀ : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
    ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set E) ∩
      {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α}) =
      plane p₀ n ∩ cone2 V u (Real.cos α)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, SetLike.mem_coe, l14_mem_plane_iff,
    l14_mem_cone2_iff hu hα]

name: Dandelin.l14_regime_R3
statement:
theorem l14_regime_R3 {V u n p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2)
    (hc : V ∉ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) :
    (Real.sin α < |⟪u, n⟫| ↔
      ((∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
          (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) →
            X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) ∨
        (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
          (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) →
            X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α)) ∧
      Bornology.IsBounded ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) ∩
        {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α})) ∧
    (|⟪u, n⟫| < Real.sin α ↔
      (∃ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, angle (X - V) u = α) ∧
        (∃ Y ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, angle (Y - V) u = Real.pi - α)) ∧
    (Real.sin α < |⟪u, n⟫| → 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ →
      ∃ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, angle (X - V) u = α)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hks, hk, hs, hαI⟩ := l14_cos_sin hα0 hα1
  have hc' : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hc; rw [l14_mem_plane_iff]
    show ⟪V - p₀, n⟫ = 0
    rw [show V - p₀ = -(p₀ - V) by abel, inner_neg_left, h, neg_zero]
  have hV : ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, X ≠ V := fun X hX h => hc (h ▸ hX)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := regime_R3 hu hn hks hk hs hc'
  have up : ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
      (angle (X - V) u = α ↔ X ∈ cone V u (Real.cos α)) := fun X hX => by
    rw [← l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI]; simp [hV X hX]
  have lo : ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
      (angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α ↔ X ∈ cone V (-u) (Real.cos α)) := fun X hX => by
    rw [← l14_mem_lower_iff hu hαI]; simp [hV X hX]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h1, l14_section_eq hu hαI]
    simp only [l14_mem_cone_iff hu hαI, l14_mem_cone2_iff hu hαI, l14_mem_lower_iff hu hαI]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hh, hb⟩
      exact ⟨hh.imp (fun h X hX => h X (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX))
        (fun h X hX => h X (l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX)), hb⟩
    · rintro ⟨hh, hb⟩
      exact ⟨hh.imp (fun h X hX => h X (l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hX))
        (fun h X hX => h X (l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hX)), hb⟩
  · rw [h2]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨X, hX, hXc⟩, ⟨Y, hY, hYc⟩⟩
      exact ⟨⟨X, l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hX, (up X (l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hX)).2 hXc⟩,
        ⟨Y, l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hY, (lo Y (l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hY)).2 hYc⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨X, hX, hXc⟩, ⟨Y, hY, hYc⟩⟩
      exact ⟨⟨X, l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hX, (up X hX).1 hXc⟩, ⟨Y, l14_mem_plane_iff.1 hY, (lo Y hY).1 hYc⟩⟩
  · intro hm hmc
    obtain ⟨X, hX, hXc⟩ := h3 hm hmc
    exact ⟨X, l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hX, (up X (l14_mem_plane_iff.2 hX)).2 hXc⟩

name: Dandelin.l14_apex_R3
statement:
theorem l14_apex_R3 {V u n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) :
    (Real.sin α < |⟪u, n⟫| → (AffineSubspace.mk' V (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set _) ∩
      {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α} = {V}) ∧
    (|⟪u, n⟫| = Real.sin α → u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n ≠ 0 ∧ (AffineSubspace.mk' V (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set _) ∩
      {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α} =
        (line[ℝ, V, V + (u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n)] : Set _)) ∧
    (|⟪u, n⟫| < Real.sin α → ∃ f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∃ ρ : ℝ,
      ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪f, u⟫ = 0 ∧ ⟪f, n⟫ = 0 ∧ 0 < ρ ∧
      (AffineSubspace.mk' V (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set _) ∩
        {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α} =
        (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) + ρ • f)] : Set _) ∪
          (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) - ρ • f)] : Set _) ∧
      (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) + ρ • f)] : Set _) ∩
          (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) - ρ • f)] : Set _) = {V})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hks, hk, hs, hαI⟩ := l14_cos_sin hα0 hα1
  have hc : ⟪V - V, n⟫ = 0 := by simp
  obtain ⟨A, B, C⟩ := apex_section_R3 (p₀ := V) hu hn hks hk hs hc
  have hsec := l14_section_eq (V := V) (p₀ := V) (n := n) hu hαI
  have hline : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      (line[ℝ, V, V + w] : Set _) = {X | ∃ t : ℝ, X = V + t • w} := by
    intro w; ext X
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq,
      AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module', Set.mem_ofPred_eq, add_sub_cancel_left]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩; exact ⟨t, add_comm _ _⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩; exact ⟨t, add_comm _ _⟩
  refine ⟨fun hm => hsec.trans (A hm), fun hm => ?_, fun hm => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨h0, h⟩ := B hm
    exact ⟨h0, by rw [hsec, h, hline]; rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨f, hf, hfu, hfn, hρ, h, hmeet⟩ := C hm
    refine ⟨f, apexRho ⟪u, n⟫ (Real.cos α) (Real.sin α), hf, hfu, hfn, hρ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsec, h, hline, hline]; rfl
    · rw [hline, hline]
      ext X
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨t, rfl⟩, ⟨t', ht'⟩⟩
        obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := hmeet t t' ht'
        simp
      · rintro rfl; exact ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, ⟨0, by simp⟩⟩

name: Dandelin.l14w_inner3
statement:
theorem l14w_inner3 (a b c x y z : ℝ) :
    ⟪(!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[x, y, z]⟫ = a * x + b * y + c * z
proof:
:= by
  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring

name: Dandelin.l14w_norm3
statement:
theorem l14w_norm3 (a b c : ℝ) :
    ‖(!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]; simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: Dandelin.l14w_sub3
statement:
theorem l14w_sub3 (a b c x y z : ℝ) :
    (!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[x, y, z] = !₂[a - x, b - y, c - z]
proof:
:= by
  ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp

name: Dandelin.l14w_unit
statement:
theorem l14w_unit {a b c : ℝ} (h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = 1) :
    ‖(!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [l14w_norm3, h, Real.sqrt_one]

name: Dandelin.l14w_ne3
statement:
theorem l14w_ne3 {a b c x y z : ℝ} (h : a ≠ x ∨ b ≠ y ∨ c ≠ z) :
    (!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ≠ !₂[x, y, z]
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have h0 := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => v 0) he
  have h1 := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => v 1) he
  have h2 := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => v 2) he
  simp at h0 h1 h2
  rcases h with h | h | h <;> contradiction

name: Dandelin.l14w_mem_plane
statement:
theorem l14w_mem_plane {p₀ n X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} (h : ⟪X - p₀, n⟫ = 0) :
    X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ
proof: := l14_mem_plane_iff.2 h

name: Dandelin.l14w_alpha
statement:
theorem l14w_alpha : 0 < Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧ Real.arccos (4 / 5) < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) = 3 / 5 ∧ Real.cos (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) = 4 / 5
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Real.arccos_pos.2 (by norm_num), Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.2 (by norm_num), ?_,
    Real.cos_arccos (by norm_num) (by norm_num)⟩
  rw [Real.sin_arccos, show (1 : ℝ) - (4 / 5) ^ 2 = (3 / 5) ^ 2 by norm_num,
    Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]

name: Dandelin.l14w_angle
statement:
theorem l14w_angle {a b c r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hn : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = r ^ 2)
    (hc : c = 4 / 5 * r ∨ c = -(4 / 5) * r) :
    angle (!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      if c = 4 / 5 * r then Real.arccos (4 / 5) else Real.pi - Real.arccos (4 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  rw [InnerProductGeometry.angle, l14w_inner3, l14w_norm3, l14w_unit (by norm_num), hn,
    Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  rcases hc with h | h
  · rw [if_pos h, h]; congr 1; field_simp; ring
  · have hne : ¬ c = 4 / 5 * r := by rw [h]; intro h'; linarith
    rw [if_neg hne, ← Real.arccos_neg, h]; congr 1; field_simp; ring

name: Dandelin.l14w_dandelin_ellipse
statement:
theorem l14w_dandelin_ellipse :
    ‖(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 ∧
    ‖(!₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 ∧
    0 < Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧ Real.arccos (4 / 5) < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) <
      |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫| ∧
    0 < ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫ *
      ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0], !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫ ∧
    |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫| < 1 ∧
    (∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧
      (⟨!₂[0, 0, 0] + d₁ • !₂[0, 0, 1], d₁ * Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5))⟩ :
        EuclideanGeometry.Sphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))).IsTangentAt F₁
          (AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 1] (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5])ᗮ) ∧
      (⟨!₂[0, 0, 0] + d₂ • !₂[0, 0, 1], d₂ * Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5))⟩ :
        EuclideanGeometry.Sphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))).IsTangentAt F₂
          (AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 1] (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5])ᗮ) ∧
      F₁ ≠ F₂ ∧ 0 < L ∧
      ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' (!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
          (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5])ᗮ,
        ((X = !₂[0, 0, 0] ∨ angle (X - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] = Real.arccos (4 / 5)) ↔
          dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = L)) ∧
    (!₂[0, 12 / 25, 16 / 25] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 1] (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5])ᗮ ∧
    (!₂[0, 12 / 25, 16 / 25] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ≠ !₂[0, 0, 0] ∧
    angle ((!₂[0, 12 / 25, 16 / 25] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧
    ∀ b : ℝ, ((AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 1] (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5])ᗮ ⊓
      AffineSubspace.mk' (!₂[0, 0, 0] + b • !₂[0, 0, 1]) (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 0, 1])ᗮ :
        AffineSubspace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha0, ha1, hsin, -⟩ := l14w_alpha
  have hu : ‖(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 := l14w_unit (by norm_num)
  have hn : ‖(!₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 := l14w_unit (by norm_num)
  have hm : ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫ = 4 / 5 := by
    rw [l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  have hm' : Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) <
      |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫| := by
    rw [hm, hsin]; norm_num [abs_of_pos]
  have hc : 0 < ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫ *
      ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0], !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫ := by
    rw [hm, l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  have hm1 : |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5]⟫| < 1 := by
    rw [hm]; norm_num [abs_of_pos]
  refine ⟨hu, hn, ha0, ha1, hm', hc, hm1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, L, hd₁, hd, hL, -, ht₁, ht₂, -, hsec⟩ :=
      l14_dandelin_ellipse hu hn ha0 ha1 hm' hc
    have hne : F₁ ≠ F₂ := by
      rw [(l14_isTangentAt_plane hn ht₁).1, (l14_isTangentAt_plane hn ht₂).1]
      exact l14_proj_ne hu hn (by rw [hm]; norm_num) hd.ne
    exact ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, L, hd₁, hd, ht₁, ht₂, hne, hL, hsec⟩
  · apply l14w_mem_plane; rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  · exact l14w_ne3 (by norm_num)
  · rw [l14w_sub3, sub_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero, l14w_angle (r := 4 / 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (Or.inl (by norm_num)), if_pos (by norm_num)]
  · intro b
    refine ⟨!₂[0, (4 - 4 * b) / 3, b], ?_⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, AffineSubspace.mem_inf_iff]
    refine ⟨l14w_mem_plane ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; ring
    · rw [AffineSubspace.mem_mk', vsub_eq_sub, Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left]
      have e : (!₂[0, 0, 0] + b • !₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) = !₂[0, 0, b] := by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
      rw [e, l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; ring

name: Dandelin.l14w_V
statement: theorem l14w_V : (!₂[0, 0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp

name: Dandelin.l14w_angle_up
statement:
theorem l14w_angle_up {a b c r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hn : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = r ^ 2)
    (hc : c = 4 / 5 * r) :
    angle ((!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  rw [l14w_V, sub_zero, l14w_angle hr hn (Or.inl hc), if_pos hc]

name: Dandelin.l14w_angle_down
statement:
theorem l14w_angle_down {a b c r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hn : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = r ^ 2)
    (hc : c = -(4 / 5) * r) :
    angle ((!₂[a, b, c] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.pi - Real.arccos (4 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ¬ c = 4 / 5 * r := by rw [hc]; intro h; linarith
  rw [l14w_V, sub_zero, l14w_angle hr hn (Or.inr hc), if_neg hne]

name: Dandelin.l14w_dandelin_hyperbola
statement:
theorem l14w_dandelin_hyperbola :
    ‖(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 ∧
    ‖(!₂[1, 0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 ∧
    0 < Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧ Real.arccos (4 / 5) < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[1, 0, 0]⟫| < Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) ∧
    (!₂[0, 0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∉
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[1, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ ∧
    (∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∃ L : ℝ, d₂ < 0 ∧ 0 < d₁ ∧
      (⟨!₂[0, 0, 0] + d₁ • !₂[0, 0, 1], |d₁| * Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5))⟩ :
        EuclideanGeometry.Sphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))).IsTangentAt F₁
          (AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[1, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ) ∧
      (⟨!₂[0, 0, 0] + d₂ • !₂[0, 0, 1], |d₂| * Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5))⟩ :
        EuclideanGeometry.Sphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))).IsTangentAt F₂
          (AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[1, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ) ∧
      F₁ ≠ F₂ ∧ 0 < L ∧
      ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' (!₂[1, 0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ,
        ((X = !₂[0, 0, 0] ∨ angle (X - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] = Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∨
          angle (X - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] = Real.pi - Real.arccos (4 / 5)) ↔
          |dist X F₁ - dist X F₂| = L)) ∧
    (!₂[1, 0, 4 / 3] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[1, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ ∧
    angle ((!₂[1, 0, 4 / 3] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧
    (!₂[1, 0, -4 / 3] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[1, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ ∧
    angle ((!₂[1, 0, -4 / 3] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.pi - Real.arccos (4 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha0, ha1, hsin, -⟩ := l14w_alpha
  have hu : ‖(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 := l14w_unit (by norm_num)
  have hn : ‖(!₂[1, 0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 := l14w_unit (by norm_num)
  have hm : ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[1, 0, 0]⟫ = 0 := by
    rw [l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  have hm' : |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[1, 0, 0]⟫| <
      Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) := by rw [hm, hsin]; norm_num
  have hc : (!₂[0, 0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∉
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[1, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ := by
    rw [l14_mem_plane_iff]; show ¬ ⟪_ - _, _⟫ = 0
    rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  have hXu : (!₂[1, 0, 4 / 3] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[1, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[1, 0, 0])ᗮ := by
    apply l14w_mem_plane; rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  have hXu' := l14w_angle_up (a := 1) (b := 0) (c := 4 / 3) (r := 5 / 3) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨hu, hn, ha0, ha1, hm', hc, ?_, hXu, hXu', ?_,
    l14w_angle_down (r := 5 / 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)⟩
  · obtain ⟨-, d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, L, hd₂, hd₁, hL, -, ht₁, ht₂, -, -, hiff, -⟩ :=
      l14_dandelin_hyperbola hu hn ha0 ha1 hm' hc
    have hne : F₁ ≠ F₂ := by
      rw [(l14_isTangentAt_plane hn ht₁).1, (l14_isTangentAt_plane hn ht₂).1]
      exact l14_proj_ne hu hn (by rw [hm]; norm_num) (by linarith)
    exact ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, L, hd₂, hd₁, ht₁, ht₂, hne, hL, hiff⟩
  · apply l14w_mem_plane; rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num

name: Dandelin.l14w_parabola
statement:
theorem l14w_parabola :
    ‖(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 ∧
    ‖(!₂[4 / 5, 0, 3 / 5] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 ∧
    0 < Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧ Real.arccos (4 / 5) < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[4 / 5, 0, 3 / 5]⟫| =
      Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) ∧
    0 < ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[4 / 5, 0, 3 / 5]⟫ *
      ⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0], !₂[4 / 5, 0, 3 / 5]⟫ ∧
    (!₂[3 / 8, 0, 1 / 2] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 1] (ℝ ∙ !₂[4 / 5, 0, 3 / 5])ᗮ ∧
    (!₂[3 / 8, 0, 1 / 2] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ≠ !₂[0, 0, 0] ∧
    angle ((!₂[3 / 8, 0, 1 / 2] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha0, ha1, hsin, -⟩ := l14w_alpha
  refine ⟨l14w_unit (by norm_num), l14w_unit (by norm_num), ha0, ha1, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    l14w_ne3 (by norm_num), l14w_angle_up (r := 5 / 8) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)⟩
  · rw [l14w_inner3, hsin]; norm_num [abs_of_pos]
  · rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  · apply l14w_mem_plane; rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num

name: Dandelin.l14w_apex
statement:
theorem l14w_apex :
    Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) <
      |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 0, 1]⟫| ∧
    |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[4 / 5, 0, 3 / 5]⟫| =
      Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) ∧
    |⟪(!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), !₂[0, 1, 0]⟫| < Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5)) ∧
    ‖(!₂[0, 1, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))‖ = 1 ∧
    (!₂[-3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[4 / 5, 0, 3 / 5])ᗮ ∧
    angle ((!₂[-3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧
    (!₂[3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 1, 0])ᗮ ∧
    (!₂[-3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 0] (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 1, 0])ᗮ ∧
    angle ((!₂[3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧
    angle ((!₂[-3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧
    (!₂[3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ≠ !₂[-3, 0, 4] ∧
    (!₂[3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ≠ !₂[0, 0, 0] ∧
    (!₂[-3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ≠ !₂[0, 0, 0]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hsin, -⟩ := l14w_alpha
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, l14w_unit (by norm_num), ?_,
    l14w_angle_up (r := 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num), ?_, ?_,
    l14w_angle_up (r := 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
    l14w_angle_up (r := 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
    l14w_ne3 (by norm_num), l14w_ne3 (by norm_num), l14w_ne3 (by norm_num)⟩
  · rw [l14w_inner3, hsin]; norm_num
  · rw [l14w_inner3, hsin]; norm_num [abs_of_pos]
  · rw [l14w_inner3, hsin]; norm_num
  all_goals apply l14w_mem_plane; rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num

name: Dandelin.l14w_regime_inscribed
statement:
theorem l14w_regime_inscribed :
    (!₂[0, 0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ∉
      AffineSubspace.mk' !₂[0, 0, 1] (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5])ᗮ ∧
    (∃ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' (!₂[0, 0, 1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
        (ℝ ∙ !₂[0, 3 / 5, 4 / 5])ᗮ, angle (X - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] = Real.arccos (4 / 5)) ∧
    (!₂[3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ≠ !₂[0, 0, 0] ∧
    angle ((!₂[3, 0, 4] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) - !₂[0, 0, 0]) !₂[0, 0, 1] =
      Real.arccos (4 / 5) ∧
    (∃ T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      (⟨!₂[0, 0, 0] + (1 : ℝ) • !₂[0, 0, 1], 1 * Real.sin (Real.arccos (4 / 5))⟩ :
        EuclideanGeometry.Sphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))).IsTangentAt T
          line[ℝ, !₂[0, 0, 0], !₂[3, 0, 4]])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha0, ha1, -, -⟩ := l14w_alpha
  have hX := l14w_angle_up (a := 3) (b := 0) (c := 4) (r := 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, l14w_ne3 (by norm_num), hX,
    (l14_inscribed (l14w_unit (by norm_num)) ha0 ha1 one_pos (l14w_ne3 (by norm_num)) hX).1⟩
  · rw [l14_mem_plane_iff]; show ¬ ⟪_ - _, _⟫ = 0
    rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num
  · refine ⟨!₂[0, 12 / 25, 16 / 25], ?_,
      l14w_angle_up (r := 4 / 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)⟩
    apply l14w_mem_plane; rw [l14w_sub3, l14w_inner3]; norm_num

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_inner_self
statement: lemma l15_inner_self (x : E3) : inner ℝ x x = ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof: := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq x

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_unit
statement: lemma l15_unit {x : E3} (hx : x ≠ 0) : ‖‖x‖⁻¹ • x‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hx)]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_plane_normal
statement:
lemma l15_plane_normal (P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3) (hP : Module.finrank ℝ P.direction = 2) :
    ∃ p₀ n : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ p₀ ∈ P ∧ P.direction = (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ∧
      ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (P : Set E3).Nonempty := by
    rw [AffineSubspace.nonempty_iff_ne_bot]
    rintro rfl
    rw [AffineSubspace.direction_bot, finrank_bot] at hP
    omega
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hne
  have h3 : Module.finrank ℝ E3 = 3 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  have hsum := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal P.direction
  have hperp : Module.finrank ℝ P.directionᗮ = 1 := by omega
  have hne' : P.directionᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h; rw [h, finrank_bot] at hperp; omega
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne'
  set n := ‖v‖⁻¹ • v
  have hn : ‖n‖ = 1 := l15_unit hv0
  have hnmem : n ∈ P.directionᗮ := Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hv
  have hle : P.direction ≤ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left]
    exact Submodule.inner_right_of_mem_orthogonal hx hnmem
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hn; norm_num at hn
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ = 2 := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal (ℝ ∙ n)
    rw [finrank_span_singleton hn0] at this; omega
  have heq : P.direction = (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle (by rw [hP, hdim])
  refine ⟨p₀, n, hn, hp₀, heq, fun X => ?_⟩
  rw [← AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem hp₀, heq,
    Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left, vsub_eq_sub]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_planeAxisAngle
statement:
lemma l15_planeAxisAngle {u n : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3)
    (hdir : P.direction = (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) :
    Real.cos (planeAxisAngle u P) = √(1 - inner ℝ (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) n ^ 2) ∧
      0 ≤ planeAxisAngle u P ∧ planeAxisAngle u P ≤ π / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he_def⟩ : ∃ e : E3, e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← he_def]
  have he : ‖e‖ = 1 := by rw [he_def]; exact l15_unit hu
  have hnu : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hu
  have hue : u = ‖u‖ • e := by rw [he_def, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnu.ne', one_smul]
  have hnu' : inner ℝ n u = ‖u‖ * inner ℝ e n := by
    rw [hue, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm, norm_smul, he, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hnu, mul_one]
  have hproj : P.direction.starProjection u = ‖u‖ • (e - inner ℝ e n • n) := by
    rw [hdir, Submodule.starProjection_orthogonal_val, Submodule.starProjection_singleton, hn]
    simp only [one_pow, RCLike.ofReal_one, div_one]
    rw [hnu', smul_sub, smul_smul, ← hue]
  have hang : planeAxisAngle u P = InnerProductGeometry.angle e (e - inner ℝ e n • n) := by
    unfold planeAxisAngle
    rw [hproj, angle_smul_right_of_pos _ _ hnu]
    conv_lhs => rw [hue]
    rw [angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ hnu]
  have hw2 := Dandelin.norm_sub_inner_smul_sq he hn
  have hcos : Real.cos (planeAxisAngle u P) = √(1 - inner ℝ e n ^ 2) := by
    rw [hang, cos_angle, he, one_mul]
    have hin : inner ℝ e (e - inner ℝ e n • n) = 1 - inner ℝ e n ^ 2 := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, l15_inner_self e, he]; ring
    rw [hin, show ‖e - inner ℝ e n • n‖ = √(1 - inner ℝ e n ^ 2) by
      rw [← hw2, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)], Real.div_sqrt]
  refine ⟨hcos, InnerProductGeometry.angle_nonneg _ _, ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have : Real.cos (planeAxisAngle u P) < 0 := by
    rw [hang] at h ⊢
    exact Real.cos_neg_of_pi_div_two_lt_of_lt h (by
      linarith [InnerProductGeometry.angle_le_pi e (e - inner ℝ e n • n), Real.pi_pos])
  rw [hcos] at this
  linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - inner ℝ e n ^ 2)]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_cone_eq
statement:
lemma l15_cone_eq {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ π) (X : E3) :
    X ∈ cone V u α ↔ X ∈ Dandelin.cone2 V (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) (Real.cos α)
proof:
:= by
  have he : ‖‖u‖⁻¹ • u‖ = 1 := l15_unit hu
  have hpos : 0 < ‖u‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 (norm_pos_iff.2 hu)
  by_cases hX : X = V
  · subst hX
    simp only [cone, Set.mem_setOf_eq, true_or, true_iff]
    show inner ℝ (X - X) _ ^ 2 = _ * ‖X - X‖ ^ 2
    simp
  · rw [Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff_angle he ⟨hα0, hα1⟩ hX, angle_smul_right_of_pos _ _ hpos]
    simp only [cone, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hX, false_or, vsub_eq_sub]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_generator_param
statement:
lemma l15_generator_param {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} {g : AffineSubspace ℝ E3}
    (hg : IsGenerator V u α g) :
    ∃ w : E3, ‖w‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ w (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) = Real.cos α ∧
      ∀ X, X ∈ g ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, X = V + t • w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwa, rfl⟩ := hg
  have hnw : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hw0
  refine ⟨‖w‖⁻¹ • w, l15_unit hw0, ?_, fun X => ?_⟩
  · have he : ‖‖u‖⁻¹ • u‖ = 1 := l15_unit hu
    have := cos_angle (‖w‖⁻¹ • w) (‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    rw [angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ (inv_pos.2 hnw),
      angle_smul_right_of_pos _ _ (inv_pos.2 (norm_pos_iff.2 hu)), hwa] at this
    rw [this, l15_unit hw0, he, mul_one, div_one]
  · rw [mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨r * ‖w‖, ?_⟩
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_eq_add, vadd_eq_add, vsub_eq_sub, smul_smul,
        mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnw.ne', mul_one]
      abel
    · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨t * ‖w‖⁻¹, ?_⟩
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_eq_add, vadd_eq_add, vsub_eq_sub, smul_smul]
      abel

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_generator_of_unit
statement:
lemma l15_generator_of_unit {V u w : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ π)
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hwu : inner ℝ w (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) = Real.cos α) :
    IsGenerator V u α line[ℝ, V, w +ᵥ V]
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hw; norm_num at hw
  refine ⟨w, hw0, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [← angle_smul_right_of_pos w u (inv_pos.2 (norm_pos_iff.2 hu))]
  apply Real.injOn_cos ⟨InnerProductGeometry.angle_nonneg _ _,
    InnerProductGeometry.angle_le_pi _ _⟩ ⟨hα0, hα1⟩
  rw [cos_angle, hw, l15_unit hu, hwu]; ring

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_plane_sphere
statement:
lemma l15_plane_sphere {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) (Q F : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : (P : Set E3) ∩ Metric.sphere Q r = {F}) :
    |inner ℝ (Q - p₀) n| = r ∧ F = Q - inner ℝ (Q - p₀) n • n
proof:
:= by
  set h0 := inner ℝ (Q - p₀) n
  set F₀ := Q - h0 • n
  have hnn : inner ℝ n n = 1 := by rw [l15_inner_self, hn]; norm_num
  have hF₀P : F₀ ∈ P := by
    rw [hPn]; simp only [F₀]
    rw [show Q - h0 • n - p₀ = (Q - p₀) - h0 • n by abel, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      hnn]; simp [h0]
  have pyth : ∀ X ∈ P, ‖X - Q‖ ^ 2 = ‖X - F₀‖ ^ 2 + h0 ^ 2 := by
    intro X hX
    rw [hPn] at hX
    have hXF : inner ℝ (X - F₀) n = 0 := by
      simp only [F₀]
      rw [show X - (Q - h0 • n) = (X - p₀) - (Q - p₀) + h0 • n by abel, inner_add_left,
        inner_sub_left, hX, real_inner_smul_left, hnn]; simp [h0]
    rw [show X - Q = (X - F₀) - h0 • n by simp only [F₀]; abel, norm_sub_sq_real,
      real_inner_smul_right, hXF, norm_smul, hn, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, sq_abs]
    ring
  have hFmem : F ∈ (P : Set E3) ∩ Metric.sphere Q r := by rw [h]; rfl
  have hFP : F ∈ P := hFmem.1
  have hFS : ‖F - Q‖ = r := by have := hFmem.2; rwa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] at this
  have hpF := pyth F hFP
  rw [hFS] at hpF
  have hle : h0 ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖F - F₀‖]
  have heq : h0 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : h0 ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
    obtain ⟨e, he, heS⟩ := Dandelin.exists_unit_orth ({n} : Finset E3)
      (by rw [Finset.card_singleton, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; norm_num)
    have hen : inner ℝ e n = 0 := heS n (Finset.mem_singleton_self n)
    set ρ := √(r ^ 2 - h0 ^ 2)
    have hρ : 0 < ρ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
    have hρ2 : ρ ^ 2 = r ^ 2 - h0 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have mem : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ ^ 2 = 1 → F₀ + (σ * ρ) • e ∈ (P : Set E3) ∩ Metric.sphere Q r := by
      intro σ hσ
      have hP' : F₀ + (σ * ρ) • e ∈ P := by
        rw [hPn]
        rw [show F₀ + (σ * ρ) • e - p₀ = (F₀ - p₀) + (σ * ρ) • e by abel, inner_add_left,
          real_inner_smul_left, hen, mul_zero, add_zero]
        exact (hPn F₀).1 hF₀P
      refine ⟨hP', ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm]
      have := pyth _ hP'
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, mul_pow, hσ,
        one_mul, hρ2] at this
      have h2 : ‖F₀ + (σ * ρ) • e - Q‖ ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by linarith
      exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr.le two_ne_zero).1 h2
    have m1 := mem 1 (by norm_num)
    have m2 := mem (-1) (by norm_num)
    rw [h] at m1 m2
    have : F₀ + (1 * ρ) • e = F₀ + (-1 * ρ) • e := by rw [m1, m2]
    have h2 : (2 * ρ) • e = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun x => x - F₀) this
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
      rw [show (2 * ρ) • e = (1 * ρ) • e - (-1 * ρ) • e by rw [← sub_smul]; ring_nf, this,
        sub_self]
    rcases smul_eq_zero.1 h2 with h3 | h3
    · linarith
    · rw [h3, norm_zero] at he; norm_num at he
  have habs : |h0| = r := by rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, heq, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  refine ⟨habs, ?_⟩
  have : ‖F - F₀‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 (norm_eq_zero.1 (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1 this))

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_plane_sphere_conv
statement:
lemma l15_plane_sphere_conv {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) (Q : E3) (r : ℝ)
    (h : |inner ℝ (Q - p₀) n| = r) :
    (P : Set E3) ∩ Metric.sphere Q r = {Q - inner ℝ (Q - p₀) n • n}
proof:
:= by
  set h0 := inner ℝ (Q - p₀) n
  set F₀ := Q - h0 • n
  have hnn : inner ℝ n n = 1 := by rw [l15_inner_self, hn]; norm_num
  have hF₀P : F₀ ∈ P := by
    rw [hPn]; simp only [F₀]
    rw [show Q - h0 • n - p₀ = (Q - p₀) - h0 • n by abel, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      hnn]; simp [h0]
  have pyth : ∀ X ∈ P, ‖X - Q‖ ^ 2 = ‖X - F₀‖ ^ 2 + h0 ^ 2 := by
    intro X hX
    rw [hPn] at hX
    have hXF : inner ℝ (X - F₀) n = 0 := by
      simp only [F₀]
      rw [show X - (Q - h0 • n) = (X - p₀) - (Q - p₀) + h0 • n by abel, inner_add_left,
        inner_sub_left, hX, real_inner_smul_left, hnn]; simp [h0]
    rw [show X - Q = (X - F₀) - h0 • n by simp only [F₀]; abel, norm_sub_sq_real,
      real_inner_smul_right, hXF, norm_smul, hn, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, sq_abs]
    ring
  have hr2 : h0 ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by rw [← h, sq_abs]
  ext X
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hX, hXr⟩
    have := pyth X hX
    rw [hXr, hr2] at this
    have : ‖X - F₀‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (norm_eq_zero.1 (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1 this))
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨hF₀P, ?_⟩
    have := pyth F₀ hF₀P
    rw [sub_self, norm_zero, hr2] at this
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := h ▸ abs_nonneg _
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr0 two_ne_zero).1 (by linarith)

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_line_mem
statement: lemma l15_line_mem (V w X : E3) : X ∈ line[ℝ, V, w +ᵥ V] ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, X = V + t • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_eq_add, vadd_eq_add, vsub_eq_sub, add_sub_cancel_right]
    abel
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_eq_add, vadd_eq_add, vsub_eq_sub, add_sub_cancel_right]
    abel

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_line_sphere
statement:
lemma l15_line_sphere (V w Q : E3) (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (g : Set E3)
    (hg : ∀ X, X ∈ g ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, X = V + t • w) :
    (∃ x, g ∩ Metric.sphere Q r = {x}) ↔ ‖Q - V‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (Q - V) w ^ 2 = r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set a := inner ℝ (Q - V) w
  set D := r ^ 2 - (‖Q - V‖ ^ 2 - a ^ 2)
  have key : ∀ t : ℝ, V + t • w ∈ Metric.sphere Q r ↔ (t - a) ^ 2 = D := by
    intro t
    rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, show V + t • w - Q = t • w - (Q - V) by abel,
      ← (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr.le two_ne_zero), norm_sub_sq_real,
      real_inner_smul_left, norm_smul, hw, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, sq_abs,
      real_inner_comm]
    simp only [D, a]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith [h]
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hw; norm_num at hw
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hxm : x ∈ g ∩ Metric.sphere Q r := by rw [hx]; rfl
    obtain ⟨t₀, rfl⟩ := (hg x).1 hxm.1
    have hD : (t₀ - a) ^ 2 = D := (key t₀).1 hxm.2
    by_contra hne
    have hDpos : 0 < D := by
      rcases (sq_nonneg (t₀ - a)).eq_or_lt with h | h
      · exfalso; apply hne; simp only [D] at hD; linarith
      · linarith
    have mem : ∀ t, (t - a) ^ 2 = D → V + t • w = V + t₀ • w := by
      intro t ht
      have : V + t • w ∈ g ∩ Metric.sphere Q r := ⟨(hg _).2 ⟨t, rfl⟩, (key t).2 ht⟩
      rw [hx] at this; exact this
    have e1 := mem (a + √D) (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Real.sq_sqrt hDpos.le])
    have e2 := mem (a - √D) (by rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, neg_sq, Real.sq_sqrt hDpos.le])
    have : (a + √D) • w = (a - √D) • w := by
      have := e1.trans e2.symm
      exact add_left_cancel this
    have h3 : (2 * √D) • w = 0 := by
      rw [show (2 * √D) = (a + √D) - (a - √D) by ring, sub_smul, this, sub_self]
    rcases smul_eq_zero.1 h3 with h4 | h4
    · have := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hDpos; linarith
    · exact hw0 h4
  · intro h
    have hD : D = 0 := by simp only [D]; linarith
    refine ⟨V + a • w, ?_⟩
    ext X
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hX, hXs⟩
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (hg X).1 hX
      have := (key t).1 hXs
      rw [hD] at this
      have : t = a := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - a)]
      rw [this]
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨(hg _).2 ⟨a, rfl⟩, (key a).2 (by rw [sub_self, hD]; ring)⟩

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_ks
statement:
lemma l15_ks {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2) :
    0 < Real.cos α ∧ 0 < Real.sin α ∧ Real.cos α ^ 2 + Real.sin α ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith, hα1⟩,
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hα0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]), Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq α⟩

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_tangent_cone_iff
statement:
lemma l15_tangent_cone_iff {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    (S : Sphere E3) (C : Set E3) :
    TangentToConeAlong V u α S C ↔
      (∃ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧ S.center = V + d • (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) ∧ S.radius = |d| * Real.sin α) ∧
        C = Metric.sphere S.center S.radius ∩ cone V u α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨e, he_def⟩ : ∃ e : E3, e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← he_def]
  have he : ‖e‖ = 1 := by rw [he_def]; exact l15_unit hu
  have hee : inner ℝ e e = 1 := by rw [l15_inner_self, he]; norm_num
  have hαI0 : 0 ≤ α := hα0.le
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, hgen, hC⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hC⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq_def⟩ : ∃ q : E3, q = S.center - V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = inner ℝ q e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have cond : ∀ w : E3, ‖w‖ = 1 → inner ℝ w e = Real.cos α →
        ‖q‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ q w ^ 2 = S.radius ^ 2 := by
      intro w hw hwe
      have hg := l15_generator_of_unit (V := V) hu hαI0 hαI1 hw (by rw [← he_def]; exact hwe)
      rw [hq_def]
      exact (l15_line_sphere V w S.center hw S.radius hr _ (fun X => l15_line_mem V w X)).1
        (hgen _ hg)
    obtain ⟨v, hv_def⟩ : ∃ v : E3, v = q - a • e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hve : inner ℝ v e = 0 := by
      rw [hv_def, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, hee, ha_def]; ring
    have hv0 : v = 0 := by
      by_contra hv0
      obtain ⟨b, hb_def⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = ‖v‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hb : 0 < b := by rw [hb_def]; exact norm_pos_iff.2 hv0
      obtain ⟨f, hf_def⟩ : ∃ f : E3, f = b⁻¹ • v := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hf : ‖f‖ = 1 := by rw [hf_def, hb_def]; exact l15_unit hv0
      have hfe : inner ℝ f e = 0 := by rw [hf_def, real_inner_smul_left, hve, mul_zero]
      have hqv : q = a • e + b • f := by
        rw [hf_def, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb.ne', one_smul, hv_def]; abel
      have hqe : inner ℝ q e = a := ha_def.symm
      have hqf : inner ℝ q f = b := by
        rw [hqv, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm,
          hfe, l15_inner_self f, hf]; ring
      obtain ⟨g, hg, hgS⟩ := Dandelin.exists_unit_orth ({e, f} : Finset E3)
        (by
          calc ({e, f} : Finset E3).card ≤ 2 := Finset.card_le_two
            _ < Module.finrank ℝ E3 := by rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; norm_num)
      have hge : inner ℝ g e = 0 := hgS e (by simp)
      have hgf : inner ℝ g f = 0 := hgS f (by simp)
      have hqg : inner ℝ q g = 0 := by
        rw [hqv, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm g e,
          real_inner_comm g f] at *
        rw [hge, hgf]; ring
      obtain ⟨w1, w1e⟩ := Dandelin.gen_dir (k := Real.cos α) (s := Real.sin α) he hf hfe hks
      obtain ⟨w2, w2e⟩ := Dandelin.gen_dir (k := Real.cos α) (s := -Real.sin α) he hf hfe
        (by rw [neg_sq]; exact hks)
      obtain ⟨w3, w3e⟩ := Dandelin.gen_dir (k := Real.cos α) (s := Real.sin α) he hg hge hks
      have c1 := cond _ w1 w1e
      have c2 := cond _ w2 w2e
      have c3 := cond _ w3 w3e
      rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hqe, hqf] at c1 c2
      rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hqe, hqg] at c3
      have h2 : (b * Real.sin α) ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * (c1 + c2 - 2 * c3)
      have h3 : b * Real.sin α = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1 h2
      have := mul_pos hb hs
      linarith
    have hq : q = a • e := by rw [hv_def] at hv0; exact sub_eq_zero.1 hv0
    obtain ⟨w1, w1n, w1e⟩ : ∃ w : E3, ‖w‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ w e = Real.cos α := by
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfS⟩ := Dandelin.exists_unit_orth ({e} : Finset E3)
        (by rw [Finset.card_singleton, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; norm_num)
      exact ⟨_, Dandelin.gen_dir he hf (hfS e (by simp)) hks⟩
    have c1 := cond _ w1n w1e
    rw [hq, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm, w1e, norm_smul, he, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      mul_one, sq_abs] at c1
    have hr2 : S.radius ^ 2 = (|a| * Real.sin α) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, sq_abs]; linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * c1 - a ^ 2 * hks
    have hrad : S.radius = |a| * Real.sin α :=
      (pow_left_inj₀ hr.le (by positivity) two_ne_zero).1 hr2
    refine ⟨a, ?_, by rw [← hq, hq_def]; abel, hrad⟩
    rintro rfl
    rw [abs_zero, zero_mul] at hrad; linarith
  · rintro ⟨⟨d, hd, hc, hr⟩, hC⟩
    have hr0 : 0 < S.radius := by rw [hr]; exact mul_pos (abs_pos.2 hd) hs
    refine ⟨hr0, fun g hg => ?_, hC⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwe, hgw⟩ := l15_generator_param hu hg
    rw [← he_def] at hwe
    refine (l15_line_sphere V w S.center hw S.radius hr0 g hgw).2 ?_
    rw [hc, add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm, hwe, norm_smul, he,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, hr, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    rw [mul_pow, sq_abs]; linear_combination (-d ^ 2) * hks

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_vnot
proof:
:= by
  intro h; apply hVP
  rw [hPn, show V - p₀ = -(p₀ - V) by abel, inner_neg_left, h, neg_zero]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_m_sq_le
statement: lemma l15_m_sq_le {e n : E3} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) : inner ℝ e n ^ 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have := abs_real_inner_le_norm e n
  rw [he, hn, mul_one] at this
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (inner ℝ e n), sq_abs (inner ℝ e n)]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_regime_ell
statement:
lemma l15_regime_ell {α β m : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβ1 : β ≤ π / 2)
    (hm1 : m ^ 2 ≤ 1) (hcos : Real.cos β = √(1 - m ^ 2)) (h : α < β) : Real.sin α < |m|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have h1 : Real.cos β < Real.cos α :=
    Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hα0.le (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) h
  rw [hcos] at h1
  have h2 : 1 - m ^ 2 < Real.cos α ^ 2 := (Real.sqrt_lt' hk).1 h1
  by_contra h3; push_neg at h3
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg m, sq_abs m]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_regime_hyp
statement:
lemma l15_regime_hyp {α β m : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β)
    (hm1 : m ^ 2 ≤ 1) (hcos : Real.cos β = √(1 - m ^ 2)) (h : β < α) : |m| < Real.sin α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have h1 : Real.cos α < Real.cos β :=
    Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hβ0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) h
  rw [hcos] at h1
  have h2 : Real.cos α ^ 2 < 1 - m ^ 2 := (Real.lt_sqrt hk.le).1 h1
  by_contra h3; push_neg at h3
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg m, sq_abs m]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_regime_par
statement:
lemma l15_regime_par {α β m : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    (hm1 : m ^ 2 ≤ 1) (hcos : Real.cos β = √(1 - m ^ 2)) (h : β = α) : |m| = Real.sin α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  rw [h] at hcos
  have h2 : Real.cos α ^ 2 = 1 - m ^ 2 := by rw [hcos, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]
  have : |m| ^ 2 = Real.sin α ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; linarith
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ (abs_nonneg m) hs.le two_ne_zero).1 this

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_noncirc
statement:
lemma l15_noncirc {β m : ℝ} (hcos : Real.cos β = √(1 - m ^ 2)) (h0 : 0 ≤ β) (h : β < π / 2) :
    m ^ 2 < 1
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 < Real.cos β := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith, h⟩
  rw [hcos] at this
  have := Real.sqrt_pos.1 this
  linarith

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_dandelin_data
statement:
lemma l15_dandelin_data {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    (S : Sphere E3) (C : Set E3) (F : E3)
    (hC : TangentToConeAlong V u α S C) (hF : TangentToPlaneAt P S F) :
    ∃ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧ S = l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d ∧
      |d * inner ℝ e n - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n| = |d| * Real.sin α ∧
      F = (V + d • e) - inner ℝ ((V + d • e) - p₀) n • n ∧
      C = Metric.sphere (V + d • e) (|d| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α
proof:
:= by
  have hr := hC.1
  obtain ⟨⟨d, hd, hc, hrad⟩, hCeq⟩ := (l15_tangent_cone_iff hu hα0 hα1 S C).1 hC
  rw [← he_def] at hc
  obtain ⟨habs, hFeq⟩ := l15_plane_sphere hn hPn S.center F S.radius hr hF
  rw [hc, hrad, Dandelin.inner_center_sub] at habs
  refine ⟨d, hd, EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.ext hc hrad, habs, by rw [hFeq, hc], ?_⟩
  rw [hCeq, hc, hrad]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_mk_dandelin
statement:
lemma l15_mk_dandelin {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    (d : ℝ) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (htan : |d * inner ℝ e n - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n| = |d| * Real.sin α) :
    IsDandelinSphere V u α P (l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨_, (l15_tangent_cone_iff hu hα0 hα1 _ _).2 ⟨⟨d, hd, by rw [he_def]; rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩⟩,
    _, l15_plane_sphere_conv hn hPn _ _ ?_⟩
  show |inner ℝ ((V + d • e) - p₀) n| = |d| * Real.sin α
  rw [Dandelin.inner_center_sub]; exact htan

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_two_roots
statement:
lemma l15_two_roots {m c s d d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hL : m ^ 2 - s ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hne : d₁ ≠ d₂)
    (h : |d * m - c| = |d| * s) (h₁ : |d₁ * m - c| = |d₁| * s) (h₂ : |d₂ * m - c| = |d₂| * s) :
    d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂
proof:
:= by
  have sq : ∀ x : ℝ, |x * m - c| = |x| * s → (x * m - c) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 * s ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have := congrArg (· ^ 2) hx
    simp only [sq_abs, mul_pow] at this
    exact this
  have q := sq d h; have q₁ := sq d₁ h₁; have q₂ := sq d₂ h₂
  have e1 : (d₁ - d₂) * ((m ^ 2 - s ^ 2) * (d₁ + d₂) - 2 * m * c) = 0 := by
    linear_combination q₁ - q₂
  have e1' : (m ^ 2 - s ^ 2) * (d₁ + d₂) - 2 * m * c = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 e1 with h' | h'
    · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.1 h') hne
    · exact h'
  have e2 : (d - d₁) * ((m ^ 2 - s ^ 2) * (d + d₁) - 2 * m * c) = 0 := by
    linear_combination q - q₁
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 e2 with h' | h'
  · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.1 h')
  · right
    have : (m ^ 2 - s ^ 2) * (d - d₂) = 0 := by linear_combination h' - e1'
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h'' | h''
    · exact absurd h'' hL
    · exact sub_eq_zero.1 h''

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_sOppSide
statement:
lemma l15_sOppSide {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ P)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) (x y : E3)
    (h : inner ℝ (x - p₀) n * inner ℝ (y - p₀) n < 0) : P.SOppSide x y
proof:
:= by
  have hx : inner ℝ (x - p₀) n ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0, zero_mul] at h; exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  have hy : inner ℝ (y - p₀) n ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at h; exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  rw [AffineSubspace.sOppSide_iff_exists_left hp₀]
  set t := -inner ℝ (y - p₀) n / inner ℝ (x - p₀) n
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := by
    have : 0 < -inner ℝ (y - p₀) n * inner ℝ (x - p₀) n := by linarith
    have h2 : t = -inner ℝ (y - p₀) n * inner ℝ (x - p₀) n / (inner ℝ (x - p₀) n) ^ 2 := by
      simp only [t]; field_simp
    rw [h2]; positivity
  refine ⟨fun hm => hx ((hPn x).1 hm), fun hm => hy ((hPn y).1 hm), y + t • (x - p₀), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hPn, show y + t • (x - p₀) - p₀ = (y - p₀) + t • (x - p₀) by abel, inner_add_left,
      real_inner_smul_left]
    simp only [t]; field_simp; ring
  · rw [vsub_eq_sub, vsub_eq_sub, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact SameRay.sameRay_nonneg_smul_right _ ht

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_inside_pos
statement:
lemma l15_inside_pos {V u e : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) {α d : ℝ}
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hd : 0 < d) : InsideNappe V u α 1 (V + d • e)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < ‖u‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 (norm_pos_iff.2 hu)
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he_def]; exact smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hu)) hu
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : d • e = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (· - V) h; simpa using this
    rcases smul_eq_zero.1 this with h' | h'
    · linarith
    · exact he0 h'
  · rw [one_smul, vsub_eq_sub, add_sub_cancel_left, InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ hd, he_def,
      InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ hpos, InnerProductGeometry.angle_self hu]
    exact hα0

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_inside_neg
statement:
lemma l15_inside_neg {V u e : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) {α d : ℝ}
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hd : d < 0) : InsideNappe V u α (-1) (V + d • e)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < ‖u‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 (norm_pos_iff.2 hu)
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he_def]; exact smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hu)) hu
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : d • e = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (· - V) h; simpa using this
    rcases smul_eq_zero.1 this with h' | h'
    · linarith
    · exact he0 h'
  · rw [vsub_eq_sub, add_sub_cancel_left, show d • e = -((-d) • e) by rw [neg_smul, neg_neg],
      neg_one_smul, InnerProductGeometry.angle_neg_neg, InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ (by linarith),
      he_def, InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ hpos, InnerProductGeometry.angle_self hu]
    exact hα0

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_gen_on_sphere
statement:
lemma l15_gen_on_sphere {V w e : E3} {k s d t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (hwe : inner ℝ w e = k) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (h : V + t • w ∈ Metric.sphere (V + d • e) (|d| * s)) : t = d * k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, show V + t • w - (V + d • e) = t • w - d • e by abel] at h
  have h2 : ‖t • w - d • e‖ ^ 2 = (|d| * s) ^ 2 := by rw [h]
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, hw, he, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_right, hwe, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, mul_one, mul_pow,
    sq_abs] at h2
  rw [sq_abs] at h2
  have : (t - d * k) ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination h2 + d ^ 2 * hks
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1 this)

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_gen_segment
statement:
lemma l15_gen_segment {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) (g : AffineSubspace ℝ E3) (hg : IsGenerator V u α g)
    (d₁ d₂ : ℝ) (Y₁ Y₂ : E3) (hY₁ : Y₁ ∈ (g : Set E3)) (hY₂ : Y₂ ∈ (g : Set E3))
    (hS₁ : Y₁ ∈ Metric.sphere (V + d₁ • e) (|d₁| * Real.sin α))
    (hS₂ : Y₂ ∈ Metric.sphere (V + d₂ • e) (|d₂| * Real.sin α)) :
    dist Y₁ Y₂ = |d₁ - d₂| * Real.cos α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwe, hgw⟩ := l15_generator_param hu hg
  rw [← he_def] at hwe
  have he : ‖e‖ = 1 := by rw [he_def]; exact l15_unit hu
  obtain ⟨t₁, rfl⟩ := (hgw Y₁).1 hY₁
  obtain ⟨t₂, rfl⟩ := (hgw Y₂).1 hY₂
  have e1 := l15_gen_on_sphere hw he hwe hks hS₁
  have e2 := l15_gen_on_sphere hw he hwe hks hS₂
  rw [dist_eq_norm, show V + t₁ • w - (V + t₂ • w) = (t₁ - t₂) • w by rw [sub_smul]; abel,
    norm_smul, hw, mul_one, e1, e2, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hk]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_plane_dir
statement:
lemma l15_plane_dir {p₀ n F₁ F₂ : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (h₁ : inner ℝ (F₁ - p₀) n = 0)
    (h₂ : inner ℝ (F₂ - p₀) n = 0) :
    ∃ v : E3, ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ v n = 0 ∧ F₂ - F₁ = ‖F₂ - F₁‖ • v
proof:
:= by
  have h12 : inner ℝ (F₂ - F₁) n = 0 := by
    rw [show F₂ - F₁ = (F₂ - p₀) - (F₁ - p₀) by abel, inner_sub_left, h₁, h₂, sub_zero]
  by_cases h : F₂ - F₁ = 0
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hvS⟩ := Dandelin.exists_unit_orth ({n} : Finset E3)
      (by rw [Finset.card_singleton, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; norm_num)
    exact ⟨v, hv, hvS n (by simp), by rw [h, norm_zero, zero_smul]⟩
  · refine ⟨‖F₂ - F₁‖⁻¹ • (F₂ - F₁), l15_unit h, by rw [real_inner_smul_left, h12, mul_zero], ?_⟩
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 h), one_smul]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_isGreatest
statement:
lemma l15_isGreatest {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) (Q : Set E3) (F₁ F₂ : E3) (K : ℝ)
    (hF₁ : F₁ ∈ P) (hF₂ : F₂ ∈ P)
    (hQ : ∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ Q ↔ dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = K) (hne : ∃ X ∈ P, X ∈ Q) :
    IsGreatest {d | ∃ x ∈ (P : Set E3) ∩ Q, ∃ y ∈ (P : Set E3) ∩ Q, d = dist x y} K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvn, hF⟩ := l15_plane_dir hn ((hPn _).1 hF₁) ((hPn _).1 hF₂)
  set δ := ‖F₂ - F₁‖
  obtain ⟨X₀, hX₀P, hX₀Q⟩ := hne
  have hK : δ ≤ K := by
    have := (hQ X₀ hX₀P).1 hX₀Q
    have h3 := dist_triangle_left F₂ F₁ X₀
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at h3
    linarith
  have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := norm_nonneg _
  have mk : ∀ r : ℝ, F₁ + r • v ∈ P := by
    intro r
    rw [hPn, show F₁ + r • v - p₀ = (F₁ - p₀) + r • v by abel, inner_add_left,
      real_inner_smul_left, hvn, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact (hPn _).1 hF₁
  have dist1 : ∀ r : ℝ, dist (F₁ + r • v) F₁ = |r| := by
    intro r; rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hv, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have dist2 : ∀ r : ℝ, dist (F₁ + r • v) F₂ = |r - δ| := by
    intro r
    rw [dist_eq_norm, show F₁ + r • v - F₂ = r • v - (F₂ - F₁) by abel, hF, ← sub_smul,
      norm_smul, hv, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have memQ : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| + |r - δ| = K → F₁ + r • v ∈ (P : Set E3) ∩ Q := fun r hr =>
    ⟨mk r, (hQ _ (mk r)).2 (by rw [dist1, dist2]; exact hr)⟩
  refine ⟨⟨F₁ + ((δ + K) / 2) • v, memQ _ ?_, F₁ + ((δ - K) / 2) • v, memQ _ ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; ring
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; ring
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, show F₁ + ((δ + K) / 2) • v - (F₁ + ((δ - K) / 2) • v)
        = ((δ + K) / 2 - (δ - K) / 2) • v by rw [sub_smul]; abel, norm_smul, hv, mul_one,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, show (δ + K) / 2 - (δ - K) / 2 = K by ring, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  · rintro d ⟨x, ⟨hxP, hxQ⟩, y, ⟨hyP, hyQ⟩, rfl⟩
    have hx := (hQ x hxP).1 hxQ
    have hy := (hQ y hyP).1 hyQ
    have t1 := dist_triangle x F₁ y
    have t2 := dist_triangle x F₂ y
    rw [dist_comm F₁ y] at t1; rw [dist_comm F₂ y] at t2
    linarith

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_orient
statement:
lemma l15_orient {e n : E3} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) {c s : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hm : s < |inner ℝ e n|) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∃ e' : E3, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧ e' = σ • e ∧ ‖e'‖ = 1 ∧
      s < |inner ℝ e' n| ∧ 0 < inner ℝ e' n * c
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : inner ℝ e n ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, abs_zero] at hm; linarith
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (mul_ne_zero hm0 hc) with h | h
  · refine ⟨-1, -e, Or.inr rfl, by rw [neg_one_smul], by rw [norm_neg, he], ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [inner_neg_left, abs_neg]; exact hm
    · rw [inner_neg_left]; linarith
  · exact ⟨1, e, Or.inl rfl, by rw [one_smul], he, hm, h⟩

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_sigma_sq
statement: lemma l15_sigma_sq {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) : σ * σ = 1 ∧ |σ| = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_center
statement:
lemma l15_center {V e e' : E3} {σ d : ℝ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (he' : e' = σ • e) :
    V + d • e = V + (σ * d) • e'
proof:
:= by
  rw [he', smul_smul, show σ * d * σ = (σ * σ) * d by ring, (l15_sigma_sq hσ).1, one_mul]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_S_eq
statement:
lemma l15_S_eq {V e e' : E3} {σ s d : ℝ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (he' : e' = σ • e) :
    l15_S V e s d = l15_S V e' s (σ * d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold l15_S
  rw [← l15_center hσ he', abs_mul, (l15_sigma_sq hσ).2, one_mul]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_cone2_sigma
statement:
lemma l15_cone2_sigma {V e e' X : E3} {σ k : ℝ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (he' : e' = σ • e) :
    X ∈ Dandelin.cone2 V e k ↔ X ∈ Dandelin.cone2 V e' k
proof:
:= by
  show inner ℝ (X - V) e ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * ‖X - V‖ ^ 2 ↔ inner ℝ (X - V) e' ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * ‖X - V‖ ^ 2
  rw [he', real_inner_smul_right, mul_pow,
    show σ ^ 2 = 1 by rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num, one_mul]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_dandelin_iff
statement:
lemma l15_dandelin_iff {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    {σ : ℝ} {e' : E3} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (he' : e' = σ • e) (S : Sphere E3) :
    IsDandelinSphere V u α P S ↔ ∃ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧ S = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d ∧
      |d * inner ℝ e' n - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n| = |d| * Real.sin α
proof:
:= by
  have hσσ := (l15_sigma_sq hσ).1
  have hin : ∀ d : ℝ, (σ * d) * inner ℝ e' n = d * inner ℝ e n := by
    intro d; rw [he', real_inner_smul_left]
    linear_combination (d * inner ℝ e n) * hσσ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨C, hC⟩, F, hF⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hS, htan, -, -⟩ := l15_dandelin_data hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def S C F hC hF
    refine ⟨σ * d, mul_ne_zero (by rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num) hd,
      by rw [hS]; exact l15_S_eq hσ he', ?_⟩
    rw [hin, abs_mul, (l15_sigma_sq hσ).2, one_mul]; exact htan
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, rfl, htan⟩
    have hd' : σ * d ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num) hd
    have e1 : l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d = l15_S V e (Real.sin α) (σ * d) := by
      rw [l15_S_eq (s := Real.sin α) (d := σ * d) hσ he', ← mul_assoc, hσσ, one_mul]
    rw [e1]
    refine l15_mk_dandelin hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def (σ * d) hd' ?_
    have h3 : (σ * d) * inner ℝ e n = d * inner ℝ e' n := by
      rw [he', real_inner_smul_left]; ring
    rw [h3, abs_mul σ d, (l15_sigma_sq hσ).2, one_mul]; exact htan

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_data'
statement:
lemma l15_data' {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    {σ : ℝ} {e' : E3} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (he' : e' = σ • e)
    (S : Sphere E3) (C : Set E3) (F : E3)
    (hC : TangentToConeAlong V u α S C) (hF : TangentToPlaneAt P S F) (d₀ : ℝ)
    (hS : S = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₀) :
    F = (V + d₀ • e') - inner ℝ ((V + d₀ • e') - p₀) n • n ∧
      C = Metric.sphere (V + d₀ • e') (|d₀| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, -, hS', -, hFe, hCe⟩ := l15_dandelin_data hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def S C F hC hF
  have hSe : l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₀ := hS'.symm.trans hS
  have hc : V + d • e = V + d₀ • e' := congrArg Sphere.center hSe
  have hr : |d| * Real.sin α = |d₀| * Real.sin α := congrArg Sphere.radius hSe
  rw [hc] at hFe hCe; rw [hr] at hCe
  exact ⟨hFe, hCe⟩

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_ell_pkg
statement:
lemma l15_ell_pkg {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    {σ : ℝ} {e' : E3} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (he' : e' = σ • e) (he'n : ‖e'‖ = 1)
    (hm : Real.sin α < |inner ℝ e' n|) (hc : 0 < inner ℝ e' n * inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E3, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧
      (∀ S, IsDandelinSphere V u α P S ↔
        S = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₁ ∨ S = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₂) ∧
      inner ℝ ((V + d₁ • e') - p₀) n * inner ℝ ((V + d₂ • e') - p₀) n < 0 ∧
      F₁ ∈ P ∧ F₂ ∈ P ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • e') - inner ℝ ((V + d₁ • e') - p₀) n • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • e') - inner ℝ ((V + d₂ • e') - p₀) n • n ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ cone V u α ↔ dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = (d₂ - d₁) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∃ X ∈ P, X ∈ cone V u α)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₁, hd, htan, hopp, hF₁, hF₂, hp₁, hp₂, hiff⟩ :=
    Dandelin.dandelin_exists (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) he'n hn hks hk hs hm hc
  have hc0 : inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at hc; exact lt_irrefl 0 hc
  have hconeiff : ∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ cone V u α ↔ X ∈ Dandelin.cone V e' (Real.cos α) := by
    intro X hX
    rw [l15_cone_eq hu hα0.le hαI1, ← he_def, l15_cone2_sigma hσ he']
    constructor
    · intro h2
      rcases Dandelin.one_nappe he'n hn hks hk hs hm.le hc0 with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨hneg, -⟩
      · exact h X ((hPn X).1 hX) h2
      · exact absurd hc (not_lt.2 hneg.le)
    · intro h; exact Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff.2 (Or.inl h)
  have tan_eq : ∀ d : ℝ, |inner ℝ ((V + d • e') - p₀) n| = |d * inner ℝ e' n - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n|
    := fun d => by rw [Dandelin.inner_center_sub]
  have hL : inner ℝ e' n ^ 2 - Real.sin α ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have : Real.sin α ^ 2 < inner ℝ e' n ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_abs (inner ℝ e' n), abs_nonneg (inner ℝ e' n)]
    linarith
  have r₁ := (htan d₁).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have r₂ := (htan d₂).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  rw [tan_eq] at r₁ r₂
  replace r₁ : |d₁ * inner ℝ e' n - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n| = |d₁| * Real.sin α := by
    rw [abs_of_pos hd₁]; exact r₁
  replace r₂ : |d₂ * inner ℝ e' n - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n| = |d₂| * Real.sin α := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (hd₁.trans hd)]; exact r₂
  refine ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₁, hd, fun S => ?_, hopp, (hPn _).2 hF₁, (hPn _).2 hF₂, hp₁, hp₂,
    fun X hX => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [l15_dandelin_iff hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨d, -, rfl, h⟩
      rcases l15_two_roots hL hd.ne h r₁ r₂ with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨d₁, hd₁.ne', rfl, r₁⟩
      · exact ⟨d₂, (hd₁.trans hd).ne', rfl, r₂⟩
  · rw [hconeiff X hX, hiff X ((hPn X).1 hX), dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  · obtain ⟨X, hX, hXc⟩ := Dandelin.ellipse_nonempty (V := V) (p₀ := p₀)
      (by rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; norm_num) he'n hn hks hk hs hm hc
    exact ⟨X, (hPn X).2 hX, (hconeiff X ((hPn X).2 hX)).2 hXc⟩

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_setup
statement:
lemma l15_setup {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3)
    (hP : Module.finrank ℝ P.direction = 2) (hVP : V ∉ P) :
    ∃ p₀ n e : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ p₀ ∈ P ∧ (∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) ∧
      e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n ≠ 0 ∧
      Real.cos (planeAxisAngle u P) = √(1 - inner ℝ e n ^ 2) ∧
      0 ≤ planeAxisAngle u P ∧ planeAxisAngle u P ≤ π / 2 ∧ inner ℝ e n ^ 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, hn, hp₀, hdir, hPn⟩ := l15_plane_normal P hP
  obtain ⟨hcos, hβ0, hβ1⟩ := l15_planeAxisAngle hu hn P hdir
  have he : ‖‖u‖⁻¹ • u‖ = 1 := l15_unit hu
  exact ⟨p₀, n, _, hn, hp₀, hPn, rfl, he, l15_vnot hPn hVP, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, l15_m_sq_le he hn⟩

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics1_a
statement: theorem cov_Conics1_a : classical_Conics1_a
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  have hreg := l15_regime_ell hα0 hα1 hβ0 hβ1 hm1 hcos hβ
  obtain ⟨σ, e', hσ, he', he'n, hm', hc'⟩ := l15_orient he hc0 hs hreg
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₁, hd, hiffS, hopp, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ :=
    l15_ell_pkg hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he' he'n hm' hc'
  have he'0 : e' ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at he'n; norm_num at he'n
  refine ⟨l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₁, l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₂, ?_, (hiffS _).2 (Or.inl rfl),
    (hiffS _).2 (Or.inr rfl), fun S hS => (hiffS S).1 hS, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have h1 : V + d₁ • e' = V + d₂ • e' := congrArg Sphere.center h
    have h2 : (d₁ - d₂) • e' = 0 := by rw [sub_smul]; exact sub_eq_zero.2 (add_left_cancel h1)
    rcases smul_eq_zero.1 h2 with h3 | h3
    · exact hd.ne (sub_eq_zero.1 h3)
    · exact he'0 h3
  · rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
    · rw [one_smul] at he'; subst he'
      exact ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, l15_inside_pos hu he_def hα0 hd₁,
        l15_inside_pos hu he_def hα0 (hd₁.trans hd)⟩
    · refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show InsideNappe V u α (-1) (V + d₁ • e')
        rw [he', neg_one_smul, smul_neg, ← neg_smul]
        exact l15_inside_neg hu he_def hα0 (by linarith)
      · show InsideNappe V u α (-1) (V + d₂ • e')
        rw [he', neg_one_smul, smul_neg, ← neg_smul]
        exact l15_inside_neg hu he_def hα0 (by linarith)
  · exact l15_sOppSide hp₀ hPn _ _ hopp

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_gen_segment'
statement:
lemma l15_gen_segment' {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) {σ : ℝ} {e' : E3} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1)
    (he' : e' = σ • e) (g : AffineSubspace ℝ E3) (hg : IsGenerator V u α g)
    (d₁ d₂ : ℝ) (Y₁ Y₂ : E3) (hY₁ : Y₁ ∈ (g : Set E3)) (hY₂ : Y₂ ∈ (g : Set E3))
    (hS₁ : Y₁ ∈ Metric.sphere (V + d₁ • e') (|d₁| * Real.sin α))
    (hS₂ : Y₂ ∈ Metric.sphere (V + d₂ • e') (|d₂| * Real.sin α)) :
    dist Y₁ Y₂ = |d₁ - d₂| * Real.cos α
proof:
:= by
  have c1 : V + d₁ • e' = V + (σ * d₁) • e := by
    rw [he', smul_smul, mul_comm]
  have c2 : V + d₂ • e' = V + (σ * d₂) • e := by
    rw [he', smul_smul, mul_comm]
  have ha := (l15_sigma_sq hσ).2
  rw [c1, show |d₁| = |σ * d₁| by rw [abs_mul, ha, one_mul]] at hS₁
  rw [c2, show |d₂| = |σ * d₂| by rw [abs_mul, ha, one_mul]] at hS₂
  rw [l15_gen_segment hu hα0 hα1 he_def g hg _ _ Y₁ Y₂ hY₁ hY₂ hS₁ hS₂, ← mul_sub, abs_mul,
    ha, one_mul]

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics1_b
