statement: theorem cov_Conics1_b : classical_Conics1_b
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ S₁ S₂ hS C₁ C₂ F₁ F₂ hC₁ hC₂ hF₁ hF₂
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  have hreg := l15_regime_ell hα0 hα1 hβ0 hβ1 hm1 hcos hβ
  obtain ⟨σ, e', hσ, he', he'n, hm', hc'⟩ := l15_orient he hc0 hs hreg
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, G₁, G₂, hd₁, hd, hiffS, -, hG₁, hG₂, hp₁, hp₂, hsum, hne⟩ :=
    l15_ell_pkg hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he' he'n hm' hc'
  have D₁ : IsDandelinSphere V u α P S₁ := ⟨⟨C₁, hC₁⟩, F₁, hF₁⟩
  have D₂ : IsDandelinSphere V u α P S₂ := ⟨⟨C₂, hC₂⟩, F₂, hF₂⟩
  set K := (d₂ - d₁) * Real.cos α
  have hK : |d₁ - d₂| * Real.cos α = K := by
    rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; simp only [K]; ring
  have hK' : |d₂ - d₁| * Real.cos α = K := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  
  have key : ∀ (S : Sphere E3) (C : Set E3) (F : E3), TangentToConeAlong V u α S C →
      TangentToPlaneAt P S F → ∀ i : ℝ, S = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) i →
      F = (V + i • e') - inner ℝ ((V + i • e') - p₀) n • n ∧
        C = Metric.sphere (V + i • e') (|i| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α :=
    fun S C F hC hF i hi => l15_data' hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he' S C F hC hF i hi
  have gen : ∀ (i j : ℝ) (C C' : Set E3),
      C = Metric.sphere (V + i • e') (|i| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α →
      C' = Metric.sphere (V + j • e') (|j| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α →
      ∀ g, IsGenerator V u α g → ∀ Y₁ ∈ (g : Set E3) ∩ C, ∀ Y₂ ∈ (g : Set E3) ∩ C',
        dist Y₁ Y₂ = |i - j| * Real.cos α := by
    intro i j C C' hC hC' g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂
    rw [hC] at hY₁; rw [hC'] at hY₂
    exact l15_gen_segment' hu hα0 hα1 he_def hσ he' g hg i j Y₁ Y₂ hY₁.1 hY₂.1 hY₁.2.1 hY₂.2.1
  have great := l15_isGreatest hn hPn (cone V u α) G₁ G₂ K hG₁ hG₂ hsum hne
  rcases (hiffS S₁).1 D₁ with h1 | h1 <;> rcases (hiffS S₂).1 D₂ with h2 | h2
  · exact absurd (h1.trans h2.symm) hS
  · obtain ⟨eF₁, eC₁⟩ := key S₁ C₁ F₁ hC₁ hF₁ d₁ h1
    obtain ⟨eF₂, eC₂⟩ := key S₂ C₂ F₂ hC₂ hF₂ d₂ h2
    refine ⟨K, fun X hX => ?_, fun g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂ => ?_, great⟩
    · rw [eF₁, eF₂, ← hp₁, ← hp₂]; exact (hsum X hX.1).1 hX.2
    · rw [gen d₁ d₂ C₁ C₂ eC₁ eC₂ g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂, hK]
  · obtain ⟨eF₁, eC₁⟩ := key S₁ C₁ F₁ hC₁ hF₁ d₂ h1
    obtain ⟨eF₂, eC₂⟩ := key S₂ C₂ F₂ hC₂ hF₂ d₁ h2
    refine ⟨K, fun X hX => ?_, fun g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂ => ?_, great⟩
    · rw [eF₁, eF₂, ← hp₁, ← hp₂, add_comm]; exact (hsum X hX.1).1 hX.2
    · rw [gen d₂ d₁ C₁ C₂ eC₁ eC₂ g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂, hK']
  · exact absurd (h1.trans h2.symm) hS

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_hyp_pkg
statement:
lemma l15_hyp_pkg {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hm : |inner ℝ e n| < Real.sin α) (hc : inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E3, d₂ < 0 ∧ 0 < d₁ ∧
      (∀ S, IsDandelinSphere V u α P S ↔
        S = l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d₁ ∨ S = l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d₂) ∧
      F₁ ∈ P ∧ F₂ ∈ P ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • e) - inner ℝ ((V + d₁ • e) - p₀) n • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • e) - inner ℝ ((V + d₂ • e) - p₀) n • n ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V e (Real.cos α) →
        dist X F₂ - dist X F₁ = (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V (-e) (Real.cos α) →
        dist X F₁ - dist X F₂ = (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ cone V u α ↔ |dist X F₁ - dist X F₂| = (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∃ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V e (Real.cos α)) ∧
      (∃ Y ∈ P, Y ∈ Dandelin.cone V (-e) (Real.cos α))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨-, d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₂, hd₁, htan, hF₁, hF₂, hp₁, hp₂, hup, hlo, hiff, -⟩ :=
    Dandelin.dandelin_hyperbola (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) he hn hks hk hs hm hc
  obtain ⟨hX, hY⟩ := Dandelin.hyp_both_nappes (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) he hn hks hk hs hm hc
  have hL : inner ℝ e n ^ 2 - Real.sin α ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have : inner ℝ e n ^ 2 < Real.sin α ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_abs (inner ℝ e n), abs_nonneg (inner ℝ e n)]
    linarith
  have r₁ := (htan d₁).2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have r₂ := (htan d₂).2 (Or.inr rfl)
  rw [Dandelin.inner_center_sub] at r₁ r₂
  have hσ : (1 : ℝ) = 1 ∨ (1 : ℝ) = -1 := Or.inl rfl
  have he' : e = (1 : ℝ) • e := (one_smul ℝ e).symm
  refine ⟨d₁, d₂, F₁, F₂, hd₂, hd₁, fun S => ?_, (hPn _).2 hF₁, (hPn _).2 hF₂, hp₁, hp₂,
    fun X hX hXc => ?_, fun X hX hXc => ?_, fun X hX => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [l15_dandelin_iff hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨d, -, rfl, h⟩
      rcases l15_two_roots hL (by linarith : d₁ ≠ d₂) h r₁ r₂ with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨d₁, hd₁.ne', rfl, r₁⟩
      · exact ⟨d₂, hd₂.ne, rfl, r₂⟩
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]; exact hup X ((hPn X).1 hX) hXc
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]; exact hlo X ((hPn X).1 hX) hXc
  · rw [l15_cone_eq hu hα0.le hαI1, ← he_def, hiff X ((hPn X).1 hX), dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  · obtain ⟨X, hX, hXc⟩ := hX; exact ⟨X, (hPn X).2 hX, hXc⟩
  · obtain ⟨Y, hY, hYc⟩ := hY; exact ⟨Y, (hPn Y).2 hY, hYc⟩

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics2_a
statement: theorem cov_Conics2_a : classical_Conics2_a
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  have hreg := l15_regime_hyp hα0 hα1 hβ0 hm1 hcos hβ
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, -, -, hd₂, hd₁, hiffS, -⟩ := l15_hyp_pkg hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def he hreg hc0
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at he; norm_num at he
  refine ⟨l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d₁, l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d₂, ?_, (hiffS _).2 (Or.inl rfl),
    (hiffS _).2 (Or.inr rfl), fun S hS => (hiffS S).1 hS,
    l15_inside_pos hu he_def hα0 hd₁, l15_inside_neg hu he_def hα0 hd₂⟩
  intro h
  have h1 : V + d₁ • e = V + d₂ • e := congrArg Sphere.center h
  have h2 : (d₁ - d₂) • e = 0 := by rw [sub_smul]; exact sub_eq_zero.2 (add_left_cancel h1)
  rcases smul_eq_zero.1 h2 with h3 | h3
  · linarith [sub_eq_zero.1 h3]
  · exact he0 h3

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_cone_of_double
statement:
lemma l15_cone_of_double {V e X : E3} {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (h2 : X ∈ Dandelin.cone2 V e k) (hpos : 0 < inner ℝ (X - V) e) :
    X ∈ Dandelin.cone V e k
proof:
:= by
  rcases Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff.1 h2 with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have h' : inner ℝ (X - V) (-e) = k * ‖X - V‖ := h
    rw [inner_neg_right] at h'
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (X - V)]

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_cone_of_double_neg
statement:
lemma l15_cone_of_double_neg {V e X : E3} {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (h2 : X ∈ Dandelin.cone2 V e k) (hneg : inner ℝ (X - V) e < 0) :
    X ∈ Dandelin.cone V (-e) k
proof:
:= by
  rcases Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff.1 h2 with h | h
  · exfalso
    have h' : inner ℝ (X - V) e = k * ‖X - V‖ := h
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (X - V)]
  · exact h

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_inner_u
statement:
lemma l15_inner_u {V u e X : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) :
    inner ℝ (X - V) u = ‖u‖ * inner ℝ (X - V) e
proof:
:= by
  rw [he_def, real_inner_smul_right, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hu),
    one_mul]

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics2_b
statement: theorem cov_Conics2_b : classical_Conics2_b
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ S₁ S₂ hS C₁ C₂ F₁ F₂ hC₁ hC₂ hF₁ hF₂
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  have hreg := l15_regime_hyp hα0 hα1 hβ0 hm1 hcos hβ
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, G₁, G₂, hd₂, hd₁, hiffS, hG₁, hG₂, hp₁, hp₂, hup, hlo, hiff, hXu, hYl⟩ :=
    l15_hyp_pkg hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def he hreg hc0
  have hσ : (1 : ℝ) = 1 ∨ (1 : ℝ) = -1 := Or.inl rfl
  have he' : e = (1 : ℝ) • e := (one_smul ℝ e).symm
  have D₁ : IsDandelinSphere V u α P S₁ := ⟨⟨C₁, hC₁⟩, F₁, hF₁⟩
  have D₂ : IsDandelinSphere V u α P S₂ := ⟨⟨C₂, hC₂⟩, F₂, hF₂⟩
  set K := (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α with hKdef
  have hKpos : 0 < K := mul_pos (by linarith) hk
  have gen : ∀ (i j : ℝ) (C C' : Set E3),
      C = Metric.sphere (V + i • e) (|i| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α →
      C' = Metric.sphere (V + j • e) (|j| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α →
      ∀ g, IsGenerator V u α g → ∀ Y₁ ∈ (g : Set E3) ∩ C, ∀ Y₂ ∈ (g : Set E3) ∩ C',
        dist Y₁ Y₂ = |i - j| * Real.cos α := by
    intro i j C C' hC hC' g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂
    rw [hC] at hY₁; rw [hC'] at hY₂
    exact l15_gen_segment hu hα0 hα1 he_def g hg i j Y₁ Y₂ hY₁.1 hY₂.1 hY₁.2.1 hY₂.2.1
  have hK1 : |d₁ - d₂| * Real.cos α = K := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  have hK2 : |d₂ - d₁| * Real.cos α = K := by rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; simp only [K]; ring
  
  have least : IsLeast {d | ∃ x ∈ (P : Set E3) ∩ cone V u α, ∃ y ∈ (P : Set E3) ∩ cone V u α,
      0 < inner ℝ (x -ᵥ V) u ∧ inner ℝ (y -ᵥ V) u < 0 ∧ d = dist x y} K := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvn, hF⟩ := l15_plane_dir hn ((hPn _).1 hG₁) ((hPn _).1 hG₂)
    set δ := ‖G₂ - G₁‖
    obtain ⟨X₀, hX₀P, hX₀c⟩ := hXu
    have hKδ : K ≤ δ := by
      have := hup X₀ hX₀P hX₀c
      have h3 := dist_triangle X₀ G₁ G₂
      have h4 : dist G₁ G₂ = δ := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
      linarith
    have mk : ∀ r : ℝ, G₁ + r • v ∈ P := by
      intro r
      rw [hPn, show G₁ + r • v - p₀ = (G₁ - p₀) + r • v by abel, inner_add_left,
        real_inner_smul_left, hvn, mul_zero, add_zero]
      exact (hPn _).1 hG₁
    have dist1 : ∀ r : ℝ, dist (G₁ + r • v) G₁ = |r| := by
      intro r; rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hv, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have dist2 : ∀ r : ℝ, dist (G₁ + r • v) G₂ = |r - δ| := by
      intro r
      rw [dist_eq_norm, show G₁ + r • v - G₂ = r • v - (G₂ - G₁) by abel, hF, ← sub_smul,
        norm_smul, hv, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hVnot : ∀ X ∈ P, X ≠ V := fun X hX h => hVP (h ▸ hX)
    have pos_of_upper : ∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V e (Real.cos α) →
        0 < inner ℝ (X -ᵥ V) u := by
      intro X hX hXc
      rw [vsub_eq_sub, l15_inner_u hu he_def]
      have h' : inner ℝ (X - V) e = Real.cos α * ‖X - V‖ := hXc
      rw [h']
      have : 0 < ‖X - V‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 (hVnot X hX))
      have := norm_pos_iff.2 hu
      positivity
    have neg_of_lower : ∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V (-e) (Real.cos α) →
        inner ℝ (X -ᵥ V) u < 0 := by
      intro X hX hXc
      rw [vsub_eq_sub, l15_inner_u hu he_def]
      have h' : inner ℝ (X - V) (-e) = Real.cos α * ‖X - V‖ := hXc
      rw [inner_neg_right] at h'
      have h1 : 0 < ‖X - V‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 (hVnot X hX))
      have h2 := norm_pos_iff.2 hu
      have h3 : inner ℝ (X - V) e = -(Real.cos α * ‖X - V‖) := by linarith
      rw [h3]
      have := mul_pos hk h1
      nlinarith
    set xa := G₁ + ((δ - K) / 2) • v
    set ya := G₁ + ((δ + K) / 2) • v
    have hxa1 : dist xa G₁ = (δ - K) / 2 := by rw [dist1, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    have hxa2 : dist xa G₂ = (δ + K) / 2 := by
      rw [dist2, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; ring
    have hya1 : dist ya G₁ = (δ + K) / 2 := by rw [dist1, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    have hya2 : dist ya G₂ = (δ - K) / 2 := by
      rw [dist2, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; ring
    have hxac : xa ∈ cone V u α := by
      rw [hiff xa (mk _), hxa1, hxa2]; rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; ring
    have hyac : ya ∈ cone V u α := by
      rw [hiff ya (mk _), hya1, hya2]; rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; ring
    have to2 : ∀ X, X ∈ cone V u α → X ∈ Dandelin.cone2 V e (Real.cos α) := by
      intro X h; rw [he_def]; exact (l15_cone_eq hu hα0.le hαI1 X).1 h
    have hxu : xa ∈ Dandelin.cone V e (Real.cos α) := by
      rcases Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff.1 (to2 xa hxac) with h | h
      · exact h
      · have := hlo xa (mk _) h; rw [hxa1, hxa2] at this; linarith
    have hyl : ya ∈ Dandelin.cone V (-e) (Real.cos α) := by
      rcases Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff.1 (to2 ya hyac) with h | h
      · have := hup ya (mk _) h; rw [hya1, hya2] at this; linarith
      · exact h
    refine ⟨⟨xa, ⟨mk _, hxac⟩, ya, ⟨mk _, hyac⟩, pos_of_upper xa (mk _) hxu,
      neg_of_lower ya (mk _) hyl, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [dist_eq_norm, show xa - ya = ((δ - K) / 2 - (δ + K) / 2) • v by
        simp only [xa, ya]; rw [sub_smul]; abel, norm_smul, hv, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        show (δ - K) / 2 - (δ + K) / 2 = -K by ring, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hKpos]
    · rintro d ⟨x, ⟨hxP, hxc⟩, y, ⟨hyP, hyc⟩, hx, hy, rfl⟩
      rw [vsub_eq_sub, l15_inner_u hu he_def] at hx hy
      have hnu := norm_pos_iff.2 hu
      have hx' : 0 < inner ℝ (x - V) e := pos_of_mul_pos_right hx hnu.le
      have hy' : inner ℝ (y - V) e < 0 := by
        by_contra h; push_neg at h; nlinarith
      have ex := hup x hxP (l15_cone_of_double hk (to2 x hxc) hx')
      have ey := hlo y hyP (l15_cone_of_double_neg hk (to2 y hyc) hy')
      have t1 := dist_triangle y x G₁
      have t2 := dist_triangle x y G₂
      rw [dist_comm y x] at t1
      show K ≤ dist x y
      linarith
  rcases (hiffS S₁).1 D₁ with h1 | h1 <;> rcases (hiffS S₂).1 D₂ with h2 | h2
  · exact absurd (h1.trans h2.symm) hS
  · obtain ⟨eF₁, eC₁⟩ := l15_data' hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he' S₁ C₁ F₁ hC₁ hF₁ d₁ h1
    obtain ⟨eF₂, eC₂⟩ := l15_data' hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he' S₂ C₂ F₂ hC₂ hF₂ d₂ h2
    refine ⟨K, fun X hX => ?_, fun g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂ => ?_, least⟩
    · rw [eF₁, eF₂, ← hp₁, ← hp₂]; exact (hiff X hX.1).1 hX.2
    · rw [gen d₁ d₂ C₁ C₂ eC₁ eC₂ g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂, hK1]
  · obtain ⟨eF₁, eC₁⟩ := l15_data' hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he' S₁ C₁ F₁ hC₁ hF₁ d₂ h1
    obtain ⟨eF₂, eC₂⟩ := l15_data' hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he' S₂ C₂ F₂ hC₂ hF₂ d₁ h2
    refine ⟨K, fun X hX => ?_, fun g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂ => ?_, least⟩
    · rw [eF₁, eF₂, ← hp₁, ← hp₂, abs_sub_comm]; exact (hiff X hX.1).1 hX.2
    · rw [gen d₂ d₁ C₁ C₂ eC₁ eC₂ g hg Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂, hK2]
  · exact absurd (h1.trans h2.symm) hS

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_circle_pt
statement:
lemma l15_circle_pt {V u e w : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    {α d : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2) (hw : ‖w‖ = 1)
    (hwe : inner ℝ w e = Real.cos α) :
    V + (d * Real.cos α) • w ∈
      Metric.sphere (V + d • e) (|d| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm,
      show V + (d * Real.cos α) • w - (V + d • e) = (d * Real.cos α) • w - d • e by abel]
    have h2 : ‖(d * Real.cos α) • w - d • e‖ ^ 2 = (|d| * Real.sin α) ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, hw, he, real_inner_smul_left,
        real_inner_smul_right, hwe, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, mul_pow,
        mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs]
      linear_combination (-d ^ 2) * hks
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).1 h2
  · rw [l15_cone_eq hu hα0.le hαI1, ← he_def]
    show inner ℝ (V + (d * Real.cos α) • w - V) e ^ 2 =
      Real.cos α ^ 2 * ‖V + (d * Real.cos α) • w - V‖ ^ 2
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_left, hwe, norm_smul, hw, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      mul_one, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    ring

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_span_circle
statement:
lemma l15_span_circle {V u e : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    {α d : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    ((affineSpan ℝ (Metric.sphere (V + d • e) (|d| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α) :
      AffineSubspace ℝ E3) : Set E3) = Dandelin.axisPlane V e (d * Real.cos α ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  set C := Metric.sphere (V + d • e) (|d| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α
  set k := Real.cos α
  set s := Real.sin α
  have hee : inner ℝ e e = 1 := by rw [l15_inner_self, he]; norm_num
  set c := V + (d * k ^ 2) • e
  set PiC : AffineSubspace ℝ E3 := AffineSubspace.mk' c (ℝ ∙ e)ᗮ
  have hPiC : ∀ Y : E3, Y ∈ PiC ↔ inner ℝ (Y - V) e = d * k ^ 2 := by
    intro Y
    rw [AffineSubspace.mem_mk', vsub_eq_sub, Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left,
      show Y - c = (Y - V) - (d * k ^ 2) • e by simp only [c]; abel, inner_sub_left,
      real_inner_smul_left, hee, mul_one, sub_eq_zero]
  have hsub : C ⊆ (PiC : Set E3) := by
    rintro X ⟨hXs, hXc⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hPiC]
    rw [l15_cone_eq hu hα0.le hαI1, ← he_def] at hXc
    have hc2 : inner ℝ (X - V) e ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * ‖X - V‖ ^ 2 := hXc
    rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, show X - (V + d • e) = (X - V) - d • e by abel] at hXs
    have h2 : ‖(X - V) - d • e‖ ^ 2 = (|d| * s) ^ 2 := by rw [hXs]
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, he, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one,
      mul_pow, sq_abs] at h2
    set y := inner ℝ (X - V) e
    have : (y - d * k ^ 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination hc2 + k ^ 2 * h2 + d ^ 2 * k ^ 2 * hks
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1 this)
  have hle : affineSpan ℝ C ≤ PiC := affineSpan_le.2 hsub
  have hge : PiC ≤ affineSpan ℝ C := by
    intro Y hY
    have hY' := (hPiC Y).1 hY
    have hc0 : inner ℝ (c - c) e = 0 := by rw [sub_self, inner_zero_left]
    have hYc : inner ℝ (Y - c) e = 0 := by
      rw [show Y - c = (Y - V) - (d * k ^ 2) • e by simp only [c]; abel, inner_sub_left,
        real_inner_smul_left, hee, hY']; ring
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfe, hz⟩ := l15_plane_dir he hc0 hYc
    set r := d * k * s
    have hr : r ≠ 0 := by simp only [r]; exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hd hk.ne') hs.ne'
    have g₁ := Dandelin.gen_dir (k := k) (s := s) he hf hfe hks
    have g₂ := Dandelin.gen_dir (k := k) (s := -s) he hf hfe (by rw [neg_sq]; exact hks)
    have p₁ := l15_circle_pt (V := V) (d := d) hu he_def he hα0 hα1 g₁.1 g₁.2
    have p₂ := l15_circle_pt (V := V) (d := d) hu he_def he hα0 hα1 g₂.1 g₂.2
    have q₁ : V + (d * k) • (k • e + s • f) = c + r • f := by
      simp only [c, r, smul_add, smul_smul]; rw [add_assoc]; congr 2 <;> ring_nf
    have q₂ : V + (d * k) • (k • e + (-s) • f) = c - r • f := by
      simp only [c, r, smul_add, smul_smul]
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul, add_assoc]; congr 2 <;> ring_nf
    rw [q₁] at p₁; rw [q₂] at p₂
    have hsub2 : ({c - r • f, c + r • f} : Set E3) ⊆ C := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact p₂
      · exact p₁
    have hmem := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (k := ℝ)
      ((‖Y - c‖ / r + 1) / 2) (c - r • f) (c + r • f)
    have heq : AffineMap.lineMap (c - r • f) (c + r • f) ((‖Y - c‖ / r + 1) / 2) = Y := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add,
        show c + r • f - (c - r • f) = (2 * r) • f by rw [two_mul, add_smul]; abel, smul_smul,
        show (‖Y - c‖ / r + 1) / 2 * (2 * r) = ‖Y - c‖ + r by field_simp, add_smul, ← hz]
      abel
    rw [heq] at hmem
    exact affineSpan_mono ℝ hsub2 hmem
  have := le_antisymm hle hge
  rw [this]
  ext Y
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hPiC]
  rfl

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_directrix_eq
statement:
lemma l15_directrix_eq {V u e : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    {α d : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2) (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3}
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) :
    ((P ⊓ affineSpan ℝ (Metric.sphere (V + d • e) (|d| * Real.sin α) ∩ cone V u α) :
      AffineSubspace ℝ E3) : Set E3) = Dandelin.directrix V e n p₀ (d * Real.cos α ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  ext Y
  have hs := l15_span_circle (V := V) hu he_def he hα0 hα1 hd
  have h2 : ∀ Y : E3, Y ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Metric.sphere (V + d • e) (|d| * Real.sin α) ∩
      cone V u α) ↔ Y ∈ Dandelin.axisPlane V e (d * Real.cos α ^ 2) := by
    intro Y; rw [← hs]; rfl
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, AffineSubspace.mem_inf_iff, h2, hPn]
  rfl

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics3_obligation
statement: theorem cov_Conics3_obligation : classical_Conics3_obligation
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ S C F hC hF
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  have hm := l15_noncirc hcos hβ0 hβ
  obtain ⟨d, hd, -, -, -, hCe⟩ := l15_dandelin_data hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def S C F hC hF
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = d * Real.cos α ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = inner ℝ e n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hmdef] at hm
  obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : E3, a = e - m • n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hnn : inner ℝ n n = 1 := by rw [l15_inner_self, hn]; norm_num
  have han : inner ℝ a n = 0 := by
    rw [hadef, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, hnn, hmdef]; ring
  have ha2 : ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1 - m ^ 2 := by rw [hadef, hmdef]; exact Dandelin.norm_sub_inner_smul_sq he hn
  have hae : inner ℝ a e = 1 - m ^ 2 := by
    rw [hadef, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, l15_inner_self e, he, real_inner_comm,
      ← hmdef]; ring
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at ha2; nlinarith
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfS⟩ := Dandelin.exists_unit_orth ({e, n} : Finset E3)
    (by
      calc ({e, n} : Finset E3).card ≤ 2 := Finset.card_le_two
        _ < Module.finrank ℝ E3 := by rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; norm_num)
  have hfe : inner ℝ f e = 0 := hfS e (by simp)
  have hfn : inner ℝ f n = 0 := hfS n (by simp)
  have haf : inner ℝ a f = 0 := by
    rw [hadef, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm, hfe,
      real_inner_comm, hfn]; ring
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hn; norm_num at hn
  have hm2 : 1 - m ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = (b - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) e) / (1 - m ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hpdef⟩ : ∃ p : E3, p = p₀ + t • a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpP : inner ℝ (p - p₀) n = 0 := by
    rw [hpdef, add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_left, han, mul_zero]
  have hpe : inner ℝ (p - V) e = b := by
    rw [hpdef, show p₀ + t • a - V = (p₀ - V) + t • a by abel, inner_add_left,
      real_inner_smul_left, hae, ht, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hm2]; ring
  refine ⟨p, f +ᵥ p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have : f = 0 := by
      have h' := congrArg (· -ᵥ p) h
      simp only [vsub_self, vadd_vsub] at h'
      exact h'.symm
    rw [this, norm_zero] at hf; norm_num at hf
  · rw [hCe]
    apply SetLike.coe_injective
    rw [l15_directrix_eq hu he_def he hα0 hα1 hd hPn]
    ext Y
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, l15_line_mem]
    show (inner ℝ (Y - p₀) n = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (Y - V) e = d * Real.cos α ^ 2) ↔ _
    rw [← hb]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have hYn : inner ℝ (Y - p) n = 0 := by
        rw [show Y - p = (Y - p₀) - (p - p₀) by abel, inner_sub_left, h1, hpP, sub_zero]
      have hYe : inner ℝ (Y - p) e = 0 := by
        rw [show Y - p = (Y - V) - (p - V) by abel, inner_sub_left, h2, hpe, sub_self]
      have hdec := Dandelin.decomp_of_finrank_le_three
        (by rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]) hn0 ha0 hf han hfn haf hYn
      have hYa : inner ℝ (Y - p) a = 0 := by
        rw [hadef, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hYe, hYn]; ring
      rw [hYa, zero_div, zero_smul, zero_add] at hdec
      exact ⟨inner ℝ (Y - p) f, by rw [← hdec]; abel⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [show p + r • f - p₀ = (p - p₀) + r • f by abel, inner_add_left, hpP,
          real_inner_smul_left, hfn]; ring
      · rw [show p + r • f - V = (p - V) + r • f by abel, inner_add_left, hpe,
          real_inner_smul_left, hfe]; ring

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_ecc_eq
statement:
lemma l15_ecc_eq {α β m : ℝ} (hcos : Real.cos β = √(1 - m ^ 2)) :
    Dandelin.ecc m (Real.cos α) = Real.cos β / Real.cos α
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dandelin.ecc, hcos]

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics3_a
statement: theorem cov_Conics3_a : classical_Conics3_a
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ S C F hC hF X hX
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  have hm := l15_noncirc hcos hβ0 hβ
  obtain ⟨d, hd, -, htan, hFe, hCe⟩ := l15_dandelin_data hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def S C F hC hF
  have hXP := (hPn X).1 hX.1
  have hX2 : X ∈ Dandelin.cone2 V e (Real.cos α) := by
    rw [he_def]; exact (l15_cone_eq hu hα0.le hαI1 X).1 hX.2
  have htan' : |inner ℝ ((V + d • e) - p₀) n| = |d| * Real.sin α := by
    rw [Dandelin.inner_center_sub]; exact htan
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Dandelin.tangent_of_proj hn hFe htan' hXP
    (by rw [hFe]; exact Dandelin.proj_mem_plane hn)
  have := (Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff_focal_directrix he hn hks hk hm hXP h1 h2).1 hX2
  rw [dist_eq_norm, this, hCe, l15_directrix_eq hu he_def he hα0 hα1 hd hPn, l15_ecc_eq hcos]

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics3_b
statement: theorem cov_Conics3_b : classical_Conics3_b
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ S C F hC hF
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  have hαI1 : α ≤ π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [div_lt_one hk]
    exact Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hα0.le (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) h
  · rw [h, div_self hk.ne']
  · have hcov := cov_Conics3_a V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ S C F hC hF
    have he1 : Real.cos (planeAxisAngle u P) / Real.cos α = 1 := by rw [h, div_self hk.ne']
    ext X
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hXP, hXc⟩
      refine ⟨hXP, ?_⟩
      have := hcov X ⟨hXP, hXc⟩
      rwa [he1, one_mul] at this
    · rintro ⟨hXP, hXd⟩
      refine ⟨hXP, ?_⟩
      have hm := l15_noncirc hcos hβ0 hβ
      obtain ⟨d, hd, -, htan, hFe, hCe⟩ := l15_dandelin_data hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def S C F hC hF
      have hXP' := (hPn X).1 hXP
      have htan' : |inner ℝ ((V + d • e) - p₀) n| = |d| * Real.sin α := by
        rw [Dandelin.inner_center_sub]; exact htan
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Dandelin.tangent_of_proj hn hFe htan' hXP'
        (by rw [hFe]; exact Dandelin.proj_mem_plane hn)
      have h3 : ‖X - F‖ = Dandelin.ecc (inner ℝ e n) (Real.cos α) *
          Metric.infDist X (Dandelin.directrix V e n p₀ (d * Real.cos α ^ 2)) := by
        rw [l15_ecc_eq hcos, he1, one_mul, ← dist_eq_norm, hXd, hCe,
          l15_directrix_eq hu he_def he hα0 hα1 hd hPn]
      have := Dandelin.directrix_converse he hn hks hk hm hXP' h1 h2 h3
      rw [l15_cone_eq hu hα0.le hαI1, ← he_def]; exact this
  · rw [one_lt_div hk]
    exact Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hβ0 hαI1 h

name: Dandelin.Classical.cov_Conics3_parabola_unique
statement: theorem cov_Conics3_parabola_unique : classical_Conics3_parabola_unique
proof:
:= by
  intro V u hu α hα0 hα1 P hP hVP hβ
  obtain ⟨hk, hs, hks⟩ := l15_ks hα0 hα1
  obtain ⟨p₀, n, e, hn, hp₀, hPn, he_def, he, hc0, hcos, hβ0, hβ1, hm1⟩ := l15_setup hu P hP hVP
  have hreg := l15_regime_par hα0 hα1 hm1 hcos hβ
  have hm0 : inner ℝ e n ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, abs_zero] at hreg; linarith
  have hσ : (1 : ℝ) = 1 ∨ (1 : ℝ) = -1 := Or.inl rfl
  have he' : e = (1 : ℝ) • e := (one_smul ℝ e).symm
  have hiff := l15_dandelin_iff (V := V) hu hα0 hα1 hn hPn he_def hσ he'
  have root : ∀ d : ℝ, |d * inner ℝ e n - inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n| = |d| * Real.sin α ↔
      d = inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n / (2 * inner ℝ e n) := by
    intro d
    rw [← hreg, ← abs_mul, abs_eq_abs]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact absurd (by linarith : inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n = 0) hc0
      · field_simp; linarith
    · intro h; right; rw [h]; field_simp; ring
  set d₀ := inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n / (2 * inner ℝ e n)
  have hd₀ : d₀ ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hc0 (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hm0)
  refine ⟨l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d₀, (hiff _).2 ⟨d₀, hd₀, rfl, (root d₀).2 rfl⟩, fun S hS => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨d, -, rfl, h⟩ := (hiff S).1 hS
  rw [(root d).1 h]

name: Dandelin.gen_mem_cone
statement:
theorem gen_mem_cone {V u w : E} {k t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hwu : ⟪w, u⟫ = k) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    V + t • w ∈ cone V u k
proof:
:= by
  show ⟪V + t • w - V, u⟫ = k * ‖V + t • w - V‖
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_left, hwu, norm_smul, hw, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg ht]
  ring

name: Dandelin.gen_mem_cone_neg
statement:
theorem gen_mem_cone_neg {V u w : E} {k t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hwu : ⟪w, u⟫ = k)
    (ht : t ≤ 0) : V + t • w ∈ cone V (-u) k
proof:
:= by
  show ⟪V + t • w - V, -u⟫ = k * ‖V + t • w - V‖
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_left, hwu, norm_smul, hw,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos ht]
  ring

name: Dandelin.gen_norm
statement: theorem gen_norm {V w : E} {t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) : ‖V + t • w - V‖ = |t|
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hw, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one]

name: Dandelin.gen_mem_plane
statement:
theorem gen_mem_plane {V w p₀ n : E} (hwn : ⟪w, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    V + (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪w, n⟫) • w ∈ plane p₀ n
proof:
:= by
  show ⟪V + (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪w, n⟫) • w - p₀, n⟫ = 0
  have : V + (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪w, n⟫) • w - p₀ = (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪w, n⟫) • w - (p₀ - V) := by
    abel
  rw [this, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hwn, sub_self]

name: Dandelin.gen_dir
statement:
theorem gen_dir {u e : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (heu : ⟪e, u⟫ = 0)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : ‖k • u + s • e‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪k • u + s • e, u⟫ = k
proof:
:= by
  have huu : ⟪u, u⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]; norm_num
  have hue : ⟪u, e⟫ = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact heu
  constructor
  · have h : ‖k • u + s • e‖ ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        hue, hu, he, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, mul_one, sq_abs, sq_abs]
      linear_combination hks
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one two_ne_zero).1 h
  · rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, huu, heu]; ring

name: Dandelin.exists_unit_orth
statement:
theorem exists_unit_orth [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (S : Finset E)
    (h : S.card < Module.finrank ℝ E) : ∃ f : E, ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, ⟪f, x⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  set K := Submodule.span ℝ (S : Set E)
  have hK : Module.finrank ℝ K ≤ S.card := finrank_span_finset_le_card S
  have hsum := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal K
  have hne : Kᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hb
    rw [hb, finrank_bot] at hsum
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
  have hvn : ‖v‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hv0
  refine ⟨‖v‖⁻¹ • v, ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hvn]
  · rw [real_inner_smul_left,
      Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal (Submodule.subset_span hx) hv, mul_zero]

name: Dandelin.perpN_inner_u
statement: theorem perpN_inner_u {u n : E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) : ⟪perpN u n, u⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have huu : ⟪u, u⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]; norm_num
  have hnu : ⟪n, u⟫ = ⟪u, n⟫ := real_inner_comm _ _
  unfold perpN
  rw [inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, huu, hnu, mul_one, sub_self]

name: Dandelin.perpN_inner_n
statement: theorem perpN_inner_n {u n : E} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) : ⟪perpN u n, n⟫ = 1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : ⟪n, n⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn]; norm_num
  unfold perpN
  rw [inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, hnn]
  ring

name: Dandelin.perpN_norm_sq
statement:
theorem perpN_norm_sq {u n : E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) :
    ‖perpN u n‖ ^ 2 = 1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_sub_inner_smul_sq (u := n) (n := u) hn hu
  unfold perpN
  rw [real_inner_comm] at h
  exact h

name: Dandelin.perpN_inner_orth
statement:
theorem perpN_inner_orth {u n f : E} (hfu : ⟪f, u⟫ = 0) (hfn : ⟪f, n⟫ = 0) :
    ⟪perpN u n, f⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ⟪n, f⟫ = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hfn
  have h2 : ⟪u, f⟫ = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hfu
  unfold perpN
  rw [inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, h1, h2, mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: Dandelin.perp_dir
statement:
theorem perp_dir {u n f : E} {a b : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hr : ‖perpN u n‖ ≠ 0) (hfu : ⟪f, u⟫ = 0) (hfn : ⟪f, n⟫ = 0)
    (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    ‖(a / ‖perpN u n‖) • perpN u n + b • f‖ = 1 ∧
      ⟪(a / ‖perpN u n‖) • perpN u n + b • f, u⟫ = 0 ∧
      ⟪(a / ‖perpN u n‖) • perpN u n + b • f, n⟫ = a * ‖perpN u n‖
proof:
:= by
  have hqf := perpN_inner_orth (u := u) (n := n) hfu hfn
  have hfq : ⟪f, perpN u n⟫ = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hqf
  have hx : a / ‖perpN u n‖ * ‖perpN u n‖ = a := div_mul_cancel₀ a hr
  have hq2 := perpN_norm_sq (u := u) (n := n) hu hn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : ‖(a / ‖perpN u n‖) • perpN u n + b • f‖ ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        hqf, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs, div_pow,
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hr)]
      linear_combination hab
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one two_ne_zero).1 h
  · rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, perpN_inner_u hu, hfu]
    ring
  · rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, perpN_inner_n hn, hfn]
    linear_combination (-(a / ‖perpN u n‖)) * hq2 + ‖perpN u n‖ * hx

name: Dandelin.inner_sub_V_of_mem_plane
statement:
theorem inner_sub_V_of_mem_plane {V p₀ n X : E} (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) :
    ⟪X - V, n⟫ = ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ⟪X - p₀, n⟫ = 0 := hX
  have : X - V = (X - p₀) + (p₀ - V) := by abel
  rw [this, inner_add_left, hX', zero_add]

name: Dandelin.gen_point
statement:
theorem gen_point {V u n p₀ e : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (heu : ⟪e, u⟫ = 0)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hδ : ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, ‖X - V‖ = |⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫| ∧
      (0 ≤ ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫ → X ∈ cone V u k) ∧
      (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫ ≤ 0 → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hw, hwu⟩ := gen_dir hu he heu hks
  exact ⟨_, gen_mem_plane hδ, gen_norm hw, fun h => gen_mem_cone hw hwu h,
    fun h => gen_mem_cone_neg hw hwu h⟩

name: Dandelin.mem_cone2_of_le_total
statement:
theorem mem_cone2_of_le_total {V u X : E} {k t : ℝ} (h1 : 0 ≤ t → X ∈ cone V u k)
    (h2 : t ≤ 0 → X ∈ cone V (-u) k) : X ∈ cone2 V u k
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total 0 t with h | h
  · exact mem_cone2_iff.2 (Or.inl (h1 h))
  · exact mem_cone2_iff.2 (Or.inr (h2 h))

name: Dandelin.nappe_sign
statement:
theorem nappe_sign {V u n p₀ X : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : s ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hXc : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫
proof:
:= by
  have g := gram_ineq (w := X - V) hu hn hXc
  rw [inner_sub_V_of_mem_plane hX] at g
  have hL := norm_nonneg (X - V)
  have hc2 : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hc))
  by_contra h'
  have h := not_lt.1 h'
  have h1 : 1 - k ^ 2 = s ^ 2 := by linarith
  rw [h1] at g
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hk.le hL) (neg_nonneg.2 h),
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hm) (sq_nonneg ‖X - V‖)]

name: Dandelin.nappe_sign_neg
statement:
theorem nappe_sign_neg {V u n p₀ X : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : s ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hXc : X ∈ cone V (-u) k) :
    ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ < 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := nappe_sign (u := -u) (by rw [norm_neg, hu]) hn hks hk
    (by rw [inner_neg_left, neg_sq]; exact hm) hc hX hXc
  rw [inner_neg_left] at h
  linarith

name: Dandelin.abs_lt_of_both_nappes
statement:
theorem abs_lt_of_both_nappes {V u n p₀ X Y : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0)
    (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hXc : X ∈ cone V u k) (hY : Y ∈ plane p₀ n)
    (hYc : Y ∈ cone V (-u) k) : |⟪u, n⟫| < s
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h'
  have h := not_lt.1 h'
  have hm : s ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫]
  linarith [nappe_sign hu hn hks hk hm hc hX hXc, nappe_sign_neg hu hn hks hk hm hc hY hYc]

name: Dandelin.gen_point_a
statement:
theorem gen_point_a {V u n p₀ f : E} {k s a b : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hr : ‖perpN u n‖ ≠ 0) (hfu : ⟪f, u⟫ = 0) (hfn : ⟪f, n⟫ = 0)
    (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hδ : k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n,
      ‖X - V‖ = |⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖))| ∧
      (0 ≤ ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖)) → X ∈ cone V u k) ∧
      (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖)) ≤ 0 → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := perp_dir (a := a) (b := b) hu hn hr hfu hfn hab
  have hδ' : ⟪k • u + s • ((a / ‖perpN u n‖) • perpN u n + b • f), n⟫ =
      k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖) := by
    rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, h3]
  have h := gen_point (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) hu h1 h2 hks (by rw [hδ']; exact hδ)
  rw [hδ'] at h
  exact h

name: Dandelin.hyp_both_nappes
statement:
theorem hyp_both_nappes {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (_hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    (∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k) ∧ (∃ Y ∈ plane p₀ n, Y ∈ cone V (-u) k)
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 := perpN_norm_sq (u := u) (n := n) hu hn
  have hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < s ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫,
      mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hm) (show 0 < s + |⟪u, n⟫| by linarith [abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫])]
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖perpN u n‖ := by
    rcases (norm_nonneg (perpN u n)).eq_or_lt with h | h
    · rw [← h] at hq2; nlinarith
    · exact h
  have hkm : |k * ⟪u, n⟫| < s * ‖perpN u n‖ := by
    apply abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq _ (mul_pos hs hr0).le
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hq2, show k ^ 2 = 1 - s ^ 2 by linarith]
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := abs_lt.1 hkm
  have h0 : ⟪(0 : E), u⟫ = 0 := inner_zero_left _
  have h0' : ⟪(0 : E), n⟫ = 0 := inner_zero_left _
  have dp : 0 < k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (1 * ‖perpN u n‖) := by linarith
  have dn : k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (-1 * ‖perpN u n‖) < 0 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨X, hX, -, hX1, hX2⟩ := gen_point_a (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) (a := 1) (b := 0) hu hn hks
    hr0.ne' h0 h0' (by norm_num) dp.ne'
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, -, hY1, hY2⟩ := gen_point_a (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) (a := -1) (b := 0) hu hn hks
    hr0.ne' h0 h0' (by norm_num) dn.ne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hc with h | h
  · exact ⟨⟨Y, hY, hY1 (div_pos_of_neg_of_neg h dn).le⟩,
      ⟨X, hX, hX2 (div_neg_of_neg_of_pos h dp).le⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨X, hX, hX1 (div_pos h dp).le⟩, ⟨Y, hY, hY2 (div_neg_of_pos_of_neg h dn).le⟩⟩

name: Dandelin.ellipse_nonempty
statement:
theorem ellipse_nonempty [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) : ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, heS⟩ := exists_unit_orth ({u} : Finset E)
    (by rw [Finset.card_singleton]; omega)
  have heu : ⟪e, u⟫ = 0 := heS u (Finset.mem_singleton_self u)
  have hen : ⟪e, n⟫ = ⟪e, perpN u n⟫ := by
    unfold perpN; rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, heu, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hcs : |⟪e, n⟫| ≤ ‖perpN u n‖ := by
    rw [hen]
    have := abs_real_inner_le_norm e (perpN u n)
    rwa [he, one_mul] at this
  have hq2 := perpN_norm_sq (u := u) (n := n) hu hn
  have ha0 : 0 < |⟪u, n⟫| := hs.trans hm
  have hm2 : s ^ 2 < ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hm) (show 0 < |⟪u, n⟫| + s by linarith)]
  have hsr : s * ‖perpN u n‖ < k * |⟪u, n⟫| := by
    have h := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (a := s * ‖perpN u n‖) (b := k * |⟪u, n⟫|)
      (by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hq2, sq_abs, show k ^ 2 = 1 - s ^ 2 by linarith]; nlinarith)
      (mul_pos hk ha0).le
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) h
  have h1 : -(|⟪u, n⟫| * ‖perpN u n‖) ≤ ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪e, n⟫ := by
    have h := neg_abs_le (⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪e, n⟫)
    rw [abs_mul] at h
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcs (abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫)]
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ' : δ = k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * ⟪e, n⟫ := by
    rw [hδ, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  have hmd : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * δ := by
    rw [hδ']
    nlinarith [mul_pos ha0 (sub_pos.2 hsr), sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hs.le]
  have hδ0 : δ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [mul_zero] at hmd; exact lt_irrefl 0 hmd
  have hcd : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ * δ := by
    have e2 : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 * (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ * δ) = (⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) * (⟪u, n⟫ * δ) := by
      ring
    have := mul_pos hc hmd
    rw [← e2] at this
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_right this (sq_nonneg _)
  have ht : 0 ≤ ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / δ := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hδ0 with h | h
    · exact (div_pos_of_neg_of_neg (by nlinarith) h).le
    · exact (div_pos (by nlinarith) h).le
  obtain ⟨X, hX, -, hX1, -⟩ := gen_point (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) hu he heu hks
    (by rw [← hδ]; exact hδ0)
  rw [← hδ] at hX1
  exact ⟨X, hX, hX1 ht⟩

name: Dandelin.exists_small_eps
statement:
theorem exists_small_eps {x ρ c R : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hx : |x| ≤ ρ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, ε ≠ 0 ∧ |ε - x| ≤ ρ ∧ R < |c / ε|
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : 0 < |c| := abs_pos.2 hc
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = |R| + |c| / ρ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcρ : ρ * (|c| / ρ) = |c| := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hρ.ne'
  have hcρ' : 0 < |c| / ρ := div_pos hc' hρ
  have hD0 : 0 < D := by rw [hD]; linarith [abs_nonneg R]
  have hη : 0 < |c| / D := div_pos hc' hD0
  have hηρ : |c| / D ≤ ρ := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hD0, hD]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hρ.le (abs_nonneg R)]
  have hval : ∀ ε : ℝ, |ε| = |c| / D → |c / ε| = D := by
    intro ε hε; rw [abs_div, hε, div_div_cancel₀ hc'.ne']
  have hRD : R < D := by rw [hD]; linarith [le_abs_self R]
  obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := abs_le.1 hx
  rcases le_total 0 x with h | h
  · refine ⟨|c| / D, hη.ne', abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hval _ (abs_of_pos hη)]; exact hRD
  · refine ⟨-(|c| / D), neg_ne_zero.2 hη.ne', abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hval _ (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hη])]; exact hRD

name: Dandelin.section_unbounded
statement:
theorem section_unbounded [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| ≤ s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) (R : ℝ) :
    ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k ∧ R < ‖X - V‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfS⟩ := exists_unit_orth ({u, n} : Finset E)
    (lt_of_le_of_lt Finset.card_le_two (by omega : 2 < Module.finrank ℝ E))
  have hfu : ⟪f, u⟫ = 0 := hfS u (by simp)
  have hfn : ⟪f, n⟫ = 0 := hfS n (by simp)
  have hq2 := perpN_norm_sq (u := u) (n := n) hu hn
  have hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫,
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hm) (show 0 ≤ s + |⟪u, n⟫| by linarith [abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫])]
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖perpN u n‖ := by
    rcases (norm_nonneg (perpN u n)).eq_or_lt with h | h
    · rw [← h] at hq2; nlinarith [mul_pos hk hk]
    · exact h
  have hsr : 0 < s * ‖perpN u n‖ := mul_pos hs hr0
  have hkm : |k * ⟪u, n⟫| ≤ s * ‖perpN u n‖ := by
    apply abs_le_of_sq_le_sq _ hsr.le
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hq2, show k ^ 2 = 1 - s ^ 2 by linarith]
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hε, hεR⟩ := exists_small_eps (R := R) hsr hkm hc
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (ε - k * ⟪u, n⟫) / (s * ‖perpN u n‖) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha1 : |a| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [ha, abs_div, abs_of_pos hsr, div_le_one₀ hsr]; exact hε
  have ha2 : 0 ≤ 1 - a ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs a, abs_nonneg a,
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ha1) (show 0 ≤ 1 + |a| by linarith [abs_nonneg a])]
  have hab : a ^ 2 + Real.sqrt (1 - a ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt ha2, hf]; ring
  have hδ : k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖) = ε := by
    have : a * (s * ‖perpN u n‖) = ε - k * ⟪u, n⟫ := by
      rw [ha]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsr.ne'
    linear_combination this
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hXn, hX1, hX2⟩ := gen_point_a (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) (a := a)
    (b := Real.sqrt (1 - a ^ 2)) hu hn hks hr0.ne' hfu hfn hab (by rw [hδ]; exact hε0)
  rw [hδ] at hXn hX1 hX2
  exact ⟨X, hX, mem_cone2_of_le_total hX1 hX2, by rw [hXn]; exact hεR⟩

name: Dandelin.one_nappe
statement:
theorem one_nappe {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s ≤ |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    (0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ∧ ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
      (⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ < 0 ∧ ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)
proof:
:= by
  have hm2 : s ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hm) (show 0 ≤ |⟪u, n⟫| + s by linarith)]
  have hm0 : ⟪u, n⟫ ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, abs_zero] at hm; linarith
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (mul_ne_zero hm0 hc) with h | h
  · refine Or.inr ⟨h, fun X hX hX2 => ?_⟩
    rcases mem_cone2_iff.1 hX2 with h' | h'
    · exact absurd (nappe_sign hu hn hks hk hm2 hc hX h') (not_lt.2 h.le)
    · exact h'
  · refine Or.inl ⟨h, fun X hX hX2 => ?_⟩
    rcases mem_cone2_iff.1 hX2 with h' | h'
    · exact h'
    · exact absurd (nappe_sign_neg hu hn hks hk hm2 hc hX h') (not_lt.2 h.le)

name: Dandelin.ellipse_regime
statement:
theorem ellipse_regime {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ((∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → ‖X - V‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  rcases one_nappe hu hn hks hk hs hm.le hc with ⟨h, hsec⟩ | ⟨h, hsec⟩
  · obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := section_bounded (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) hu hn hks hk hs hm h
    exact ⟨Or.inl hsec, R, fun X hX hX2 => hR X hX (hsec X hX hX2)⟩
  · obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := section_bounded (V := V) (p₀ := p₀) (u := -u) (by rw [norm_neg, hu]) hn
      hks hk hs (by rw [inner_neg_left, abs_neg]; exact hm)
      (by rw [inner_neg_left, neg_mul]; linarith)
    exact ⟨Or.inr hsec, R, fun X hX hX2 => hR X hX (hsec X hX hX2)⟩

name: Dandelin.bounded_iff
statement:
theorem bounded_iff [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    s < |⟪u, n⟫| ↔ Bornology.IsBounded (plane p₀ n ∩ cone2 V u k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    obtain ⟨-, R, hR⟩ := ellipse_regime hu hn hks hk hs hm hc
    rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall V]
    exact ⟨R, fun X hX => by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]; exact hR X hX.1 hX.2⟩
  · intro hb
    by_contra h'
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall V).1 hb
    obtain ⟨X, hX, hX2, hXR⟩ := section_unbounded hdim hu hn hks hk hs (not_lt.1 h') hc R
    have h := hR ⟨hX, hX2⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at h
    linarith

name: Dandelin.ellipse_regime_iff
statement:
theorem ellipse_regime_iff [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    s < |⟪u, n⟫| ↔
      ((∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
        (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧
      Bornology.IsBounded (plane p₀ n ∩ cone2 V u k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    exact ⟨(ellipse_regime hu hn hks hk hs hm hc).1,
      (bounded_iff hdim hu hn hks hk hs hc).1 hm⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, hb⟩
    exact (bounded_iff hdim hu hn hks hk hs hc).2 hb

name: Dandelin.hyperbola_regime_iff
statement:
theorem hyperbola_regime_iff {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    |⟪u, n⟫| < s ↔
      (∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k) ∧ (∃ Y ∈ plane p₀ n, Y ∈ cone V (-u) k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hm => hyp_both_nappes hu hn hks hk hs hm hc,
    fun ⟨⟨_, hX, hXc⟩, ⟨_, hY, hYc⟩⟩ => abs_lt_of_both_nappes hu hn hks hk hs hc hX hXc hY hYc⟩

name: Dandelin.parabola_regime
statement:
theorem parabola_regime [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| = s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ((∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧
    ¬ Bornology.IsBounded (plane p₀ n ∩ cone2 V u k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun hb => ?_⟩
  · rcases one_nappe hu hn hks hk hs hm.ge hc with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
  · have := (bounded_iff hdim hu hn hks hk hs hc).2 hb
    rw [hm] at this
    exact lt_irrefl s this

name: Dandelin.finrank_R3
statement: theorem finrank_R3 : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
proof:
:=
  le_of_eq finrank_euclideanSpace_fin.symm

name: Dandelin.regime_R3
statement:
theorem regime_R3 {V u n p₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    (s < |⟪u, n⟫| ↔
      ((∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
        (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧
      Bornology.IsBounded (plane p₀ n ∩ cone2 V u k)) ∧
    (|⟪u, n⟫| < s ↔
      (∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k) ∧ (∃ Y ∈ plane p₀ n, Y ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧
    (s < |⟪u, n⟫| → 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ → ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨ellipse_regime_iff finrank_R3 hu hn hks hk hs hc, hyperbola_regime_iff hu hn hks hk hs hc,
    fun hm hmc => ellipse_nonempty (by have := finrank_R3; omega) hu hn hks hk hs hm hmc⟩

name: Dandelin.tangent_length_sq
statement:
theorem tangent_length_sq {c F X : E} {r : ℝ} (hF : ‖F - c‖ = r)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - c⟫ = 0) : ‖X - F‖ ^ 2 = ‖X - c‖ ^ 2 - r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : X - c = (X - F) + (F - c) := by abel
  rw [h, norm_add_sq_real, hperp, hF]
  ring

name: Dandelin.tangent_lengths_eq
statement:
theorem tangent_lengths_eq {c F T X : E} {r : ℝ} (hF : ‖F - c‖ = r) (hT : ‖T - c‖ = r)
    (hF' : ⟪X - F, F - c⟫ = 0) (hT' : ⟪X - T, T - c⟫ = 0) : ‖X - F‖ = ‖X - T‖
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tangent_length_sq hF hF'
  have h2 := tangent_length_sq hT hT'
  have : ‖X - F‖ ^ 2 = ‖X - T‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h1, h2]
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).1 this

name: Dandelin.dist_eq_of_isTangentAt
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hπ.dist_sq_eq_of_mem hXπ
  have h2 := hℓ.dist_sq_eq_of_mem hXℓ
  have : dist X F ^ 2 = dist X T ^ 2 := by linarith
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg two_ne_zero).1 this

name: Dandelin.cone_tangent_sq
statement:
theorem cone_tangent_sq {V u X : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    ‖X - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2 - (d * s) ^ 2 = (‖X - V‖ - d * k) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ := hX
  have h : X - (V + d • u) = (X - V) - d • u := by abel
  rw [h, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, hX', norm_smul, hu, mul_one,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  linear_combination (-d ^ 2) * hks

name: Dandelin.cone_outside_sphere
statement:
theorem cone_outside_sphere {V u X : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) : (d * s) ^ 2 ≤ ‖X - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have := cone_tangent_sq (d := d) hu hks hX
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖X - V‖ - d * k)]

name: Dandelin.generator_dist_sq
statement:
theorem generator_dist_sq {V u X : E} {k d τ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (ht : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0) :
    ‖(V + (τ / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V)) - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2 = τ ^ 2 - 2 * τ * d * k + d ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ := hX
  have h : (V + (τ / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V)) - (V + d • u) =
      (τ / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V) - d • u := by abel
  rw [h, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, hu, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_right, hX', Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs,
    sq_abs]
  field_simp

name: Dandelin.tangencyPoint_mem_sphere
statement:
theorem tangencyPoint_mem_sphere {V u X : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hds : 0 ≤ d * s) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (ht : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0) :
    ‖tangencyPoint V X k d - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s
proof:
:= by
  have h := generator_dist_sq (τ := d * k) (d := d) hu hX ht
  unfold tangencyPoint
  have h2 : ‖(V + (d * k / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V)) - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2 = (d * s) ^ 2 := by
    rw [h]; linear_combination (-d ^ 2) * hks
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) hds two_ne_zero).1 h2

name: Dandelin.tangencyPoint_perp
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ := hX
  unfold tangencyPoint
  have h1 : X - (V + (d * k / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V)) = (1 - d * k / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V) := by
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
  have h2 : (V + (d * k / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V)) - (V + d • u) =
      (d * k / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V) - d • u := by abel
  rw [h1, h2, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hX', real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Dandelin.dist_tangencyPoint
statement:
theorem dist_tangencyPoint {V X : E} {k d : ℝ} (ht : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0) :
    ‖X - tangencyPoint V X k d‖ = |‖X - V‖ - d * k|
proof:
:= by
  unfold tangencyPoint
  have h1 : X - (V + (d * k / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V)) = (1 - d * k / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V) := by
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
  rw [h1, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← abs_norm (X - V), ← abs_mul, abs_norm]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: Dandelin.dist_tangent_eq
statement:
theorem dist_tangent_eq {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) : ‖X - F‖ = |‖X - V‖ - d * k|
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tangent_length_sq hF hperp
  have h2 := cone_tangent_sq (d := d) hu hks hX
  have h3 : ‖X - F‖ ^ 2 = |‖X - V‖ - d * k| ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs, h1, h2]
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).1 h3

name: Dandelin.dandelin_of_between
statement:
theorem dandelin_of_between {V u X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k)
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = d₁ * s) (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = d₂ * s)
    (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hb₁ : d₁ * k ≤ ‖X - V‖) (hb₂ : ‖X - V‖ ≤ d₂ * k) :
    ‖X - F₁‖ + ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₂ - d₁) * k
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_tangent_eq hu hks hX hF₁ hp₁, dist_tangent_eq hu hks hX hF₂ hp₂,
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
  ring

name: Dandelin.dandelin_of_between_isTangentAt
statement:
theorem dandelin_of_between_isTangentAt {V u X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ}
    {S₁ S₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E} {π : AffineSubspace ℝ E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k)
    (hc₁ : S₁.center = V + d₁ • u) (hr₁ : S₁.radius = d₁ * s)
    (hc₂ : S₂.center = V + d₂ • u) (hr₂ : S₂.radius = d₂ * s)
    (ht₁ : S₁.IsTangentAt F₁ π) (ht₂ : S₂.IsTangentAt F₂ π) (hXπ : X ∈ π)
    (hb₁ : d₁ * k ≤ ‖X - V‖) (hb₂ : ‖X - V‖ ≤ d₂ * k) :
    dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = (d₂ - d₁) * k
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ := ht₁.dist_sq_eq_of_mem hXπ
  have e₂ := ht₂.dist_sq_eq_of_mem hXπ
  rw [hc₁, hr₁, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at e₁
  rw [hc₂, hr₂, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at e₂
  have q₁ := cone_tangent_sq (d := d₁) hu hks hX
  have q₂ := cone_tangent_sq (d := d₂) hu hks hX
  have f₁ : ‖X - F₁‖ ^ 2 = (‖X - V‖ - d₁ * k) ^ 2 := by linear_combination q₁ - e₁
  have f₂ : ‖X - F₂‖ ^ 2 = (d₂ * k - ‖X - V‖) ^ 2 := by linear_combination q₂ - e₂
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm,
    (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith) two_ne_zero).1 f₁,
    (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith) two_ne_zero).1 f₂]
  ring

name: Dandelin.between_of_gram
statement:
theorem between_of_gram {k s m a t d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd : d₁ < d₂) (h₁ : a = d₁ * (m + s)) (h₂ : a = d₂ * (m - s))
    (hQ : 0 ≤ (1 - k ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + 2 * k * m * a * t - a ^ 2) :
    d₁ * k ≤ t ∧ t ≤ d₂ * k
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : (d₂ - d₁) * (m - s) = 2 * d₁ * s := by linear_combination h₁ - h₂
  have hms : 0 < m - s := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    nlinarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.2 hd.le) hc, mul_pos hd₁ hs]
  have hmps : 0 < m + s := by linarith
  have hsm : s ^ 2 - m ^ 2 < 0 := by nlinarith
  constructor
  · by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    have hB : 0 < (s ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * (t + d₁ * k) + 2 * k * m * a := by
      rw [h₁]
      nlinarith [mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hsm (sub_neg.2 hc),
        mul_pos (mul_pos hd₁ hk) (mul_pos hs hmps)]
    have hQ' : (1 - k ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + 2 * k * m * a * t - a ^ 2 =
        -(d₁ * (m + s) * s) ^ 2 +
          (t - d₁ * k) * ((s ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * (t + d₁ * k) + 2 * k * m * a) := by
      rw [h₁]
      linear_combination (d₁ ^ 2 * (m + s) ^ 2 - t ^ 2) * hks
    have hneg := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (sub_neg.2 hc) hB
    have hpos : 0 < d₁ * (m + s) * s := mul_pos (mul_pos hd₁ hmps) hs
    nlinarith
  · by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    have hB : (s ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * (t + d₂ * k) + 2 * k * m * a < 0 := by
      rw [h₂]
      nlinarith [mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hsm (sub_pos.2 hc),
        mul_pos (mul_pos (hd₁.trans hd) hk) (mul_pos hs hms)]
    have hQ' : (1 - k ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + 2 * k * m * a * t - a ^ 2 =
        -(d₂ * (m - s) * s) ^ 2 +
          (t - d₂ * k) * ((s ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * (t + d₂ * k) + 2 * k * m * a) := by
      rw [h₂]
      linear_combination (d₂ ^ 2 * (m - s) ^ 2 - t ^ 2) * hks
    have hneg := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.2 hc) hB
    have hpos : 0 < d₂ * (m - s) * s := mul_pos (mul_pos (hd₁.trans hd) hms) hs
    nlinarith

name: Dandelin.dandelin
statement:
theorem dandelin {V u n X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd : d₁ < d₂)
    (hF₁ : F₁ = V + d₁ • u + (d₁ * s) • n) (hF₂ : F₂ = V + d₂ • u - (d₂ * s) • n)
    (hF₂π : ⟪F₂ - F₁, n⟫ = 0) (hXπ : ⟪X - F₁, n⟫ = 0) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    ‖X - F₁‖ + ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₂ - d₁) * k
proof:
:= by
  have hwu : ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ := hX
  have hXπ₂ : ⟪X - F₂, n⟫ = 0 := by
    have : X - F₂ = (X - F₁) - (F₂ - F₁) := by abel
    rw [this, inner_sub_left, hXπ, hF₂π, sub_zero]
  
  have ha₁ : ⟪X - V, n⟫ = d₁ * ⟪u, n⟫ + d₁ * s := by
    have e : X - F₁ = (X - V) - (d₁ • u + (d₁ * s) • n) := by rw [hF₁]; abel
    rw [e, inner_sub_left, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn] at hXπ
    linarith
  have ha₂ : ⟪X - V, n⟫ = d₂ * ⟪u, n⟫ - d₂ * s := by
    have e : X - F₂ = (X - V) - (d₂ • u - (d₂ * s) • n) := by rw [hF₂]; abel
    rw [e, inner_sub_left (X - V), inner_sub_left (d₂ • u), real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn] at hXπ₂
    linarith
  
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (1 - k ^ 2 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) * ‖X - V‖ ^ 2 + 2 * k * ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪X - V, n⟫ * ‖X - V‖
      - ⟪X - V, n⟫ ^ 2 := by
    clear ha₁ ha₂ hXπ hXπ₂ hF₂π hF₁ hF₂ hX
    generalize X - V = w at *
    have hcs := real_inner_mul_inner_self_le (w - (k * ‖w‖) • u) (n - ⟪u, n⟫ • u)
    have huu : ⟪u, u⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]; norm_num
    have hnn : ⟪n, n⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn]; norm_num
    have hww : ⟪w, w⟫ = ‖w‖ ^ 2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      huu, hnn, hww] at hcs
    have c1 : ⟪u, w⟫ = k * ‖w‖ := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hwu
    have c2 : ⟪n, u⟫ = ⟪u, n⟫ := real_inner_comm _ _
    simp only [c1, c2, hwu] at hcs
    nlinarith [hcs]
  have hbt := between_of_gram hks hk hs hd₁ hd (by rw [ha₁]; ring) (by rw [ha₂]; ring) hQ
  
  have hc₁ : F₁ - (V + d₁ • u) = (d₁ * s) • n := by rw [hF₁]; abel
  have hc₂ : F₂ - (V + d₂ • u) = -((d₂ * s) • n) := by rw [hF₂]; abel
  have hr₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = d₁ * s := by
    rw [hc₁, norm_smul, hn, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hd₁ hs)]
  have hr₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = d₂ * s := by
    rw [hc₂, norm_neg, norm_smul, hn, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (mul_pos (hd₁.trans hd) hs)]
  have hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0 := by
    rw [hc₁, real_inner_smul_right, hXπ, mul_zero]
  have hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0 := by
    rw [hc₂, inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right, hXπ₂, mul_zero, neg_zero]
  exact dandelin_of_between hu hks hX hr₁ hr₂ hp₁ hp₂ hbt.1 hbt.2

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_div
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_div {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) (hb : d * k ≤ ‖X - V‖) :
    ‖X - F‖ = (⟪X - V, u⟫ - d * k ^ 2) / k
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ := hX
  rw [dist_tangent_eq hu hks hX hF hperp, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), hX']
  field_simp

name: Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cone2_iff {V u X : E} {k : ℝ} :
    X ∈ cone2 V u k ↔ X ∈ cone V u k ∨ X ∈ cone V (-u) k
proof:
:= by
  show ⟪X - V, u⟫ ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * ‖X - V‖ ^ 2 ↔
    ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ ∨ ⟪X - V, -u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖
  rw [inner_neg_right, ← mul_pow, sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]

name: Dandelin.dist_tangent_eq_abs
statement:
theorem dist_tangent_eq_abs {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) : ‖X - F‖ = |‖X - V‖ - d * k|
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tangent_length_sq hF hperp
  have h2 := cone_tangent_sq (d := d) hu hks hX
  have e : (|d| * s) ^ 2 = (d * s) ^ 2 := by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  have h3 : ‖X - F‖ ^ 2 = |‖X - V‖ - d * k| ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq_abs, h1, e]; linarith [h2]
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).1 h3

name: Dandelin.gram_ineq
proof:
:= by
  have hcs := real_inner_mul_inner_self_le (w - (k * ‖w‖) • u) (n - ⟪u, n⟫ • u)
  have huu : ⟪u, u⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]; norm_num
  have hnn : ⟪n, n⟫ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn]; norm_num
  have hww : ⟪w, w⟫ = ‖w‖ ^ 2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
  simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
    huu, hnn, hww] at hcs
  have c1 : ⟪u, w⟫ = k * ‖w‖ := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hwu
  have c2 : ⟪n, u⟫ = ⟪u, n⟫ := real_inner_comm _ _
  simp only [c1, c2, hwu] at hcs
  nlinarith [hcs]

name: Dandelin.hyp_between
statement:
theorem hyp_between {k s m a t d₁ : ℝ} (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < m) (hm2 : m < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (h₁ : a = d₁ * (m + s))
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hQ : 0 ≤ (1 - k ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + 2 * k * m * a * t - a ^ 2) :
    d₁ * k ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  push Not at hc
  have hQ' : (1 - k ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + 2 * k * m * a * t - a ^ 2 =
      (m + s) * (-((s - m) * t * (d₁ * k - t)) + d₁ * (m + s) * (k * t - d₁)) := by
    rw [h₁]; linear_combination (-t ^ 2) * hks
  have e : k * t - d₁ = -(k * (d₁ * k - t)) - d₁ * (s * s) := by
    linear_combination d₁ * hks
  have hkt : k * t - d₁ < 0 := by
    rw [e]; nlinarith [mul_pos hk (sub_pos.2 hc), mul_pos hd₁ (mul_pos hs hs)]
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (s - m) * t * (d₁ * k - t) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hm2.le) ht) (sub_nonneg.2 hc.le)
  have h2 : d₁ * (m + s) * (k * t - d₁) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (mul_pos hd₁ (by linarith)) hkt
  have h3 : (m + s) * (-((s - m) * t * (d₁ * k - t)) + d₁ * (m + s) * (k * t - d₁)) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  linarith

name: Dandelin.hyp_tangent_iff
statement:
theorem hyp_tangent_iff {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫)
    (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (d : ℝ) :
    |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = |d| * s ↔ d = param₁ V u n p₀ s ∨ d = param₂ V u n p₀ s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : param₁ V u n p₀ s * (⟪u, n⟫ + s) = ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ := by
    unfold param₁; field_simp [show ⟪u, n⟫ + s ≠ 0 by linarith]
  have h2 : param₂ V u n p₀ s * (⟪u, n⟫ - s) = ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ := by
    unfold param₂; field_simp [show ⟪u, n⟫ - s ≠ 0 by linarith]
  have e : |d| * s = |d * s| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs]
  rw [inner_center_sub, e, abs_eq_abs]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · right
      have : (d - param₂ V u n p₀ s) * (⟪u, n⟫ - s) = 0 := by linear_combination h - h2
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h3 | h3
      · linarith
      · exact absurd h3 (by linarith)
    · left
      have : (d - param₁ V u n p₀ s) * (⟪u, n⟫ + s) = 0 := by linear_combination h - h1
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h3 | h3
      · linarith
      · exact absurd h3 (by linarith)
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · right; linear_combination h1
    · left; linear_combination h2

name: Dandelin.hyp_param₁_pos
statement:
theorem hyp_param₁_pos {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    0 < param₁ V u n p₀ s
proof: := div_pos hc (by linarith)

name: Dandelin.hyp_param₂_neg
statement:
theorem hyp_param₂_neg {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    param₂ V u n p₀ s < 0
proof: := div_neg_of_pos_of_neg hc (by linarith)

name: Dandelin.focal_sq
statement:
theorem focal_sq {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s) (hp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ ^ 2 = ‖X - V‖ ^ 2 - 2 * d * ⟪X - V, u⟫ + d ^ 2 * k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have e := tangent_length_sq hF hp
  have expand : ‖X - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2 = ‖X - V‖ ^ 2 - 2 * d * ⟪X - V, u⟫ + d ^ 2 := by
    have h : X - (V + d • u) = (X - V) - d • u := by abel
    rw [h, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, hu, mul_one,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    ring
  rw [expand, mul_pow, sq_abs] at e
  linear_combination e - d ^ 2 * hks

name: Dandelin.hyp_upper
statement:
theorem hyp_upper {V u n p₀ X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫)
    (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd₂ : d₂ < 0) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ = d₁ * (⟪u, n⟫ + s))
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = |d₁| * s) (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = |d₂| * s) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    ‖X - F₂‖ - ‖X - F₁‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k
proof:
:= by
  have hXπ' : ⟪X - p₀, n⟫ = 0 := hXπ
  have ha : ⟪X - V, n⟫ = ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ := by
    have : X - V = (X - p₀) + (p₀ - V) := by abel
    rw [this, inner_add_left, hXπ', zero_add]
  have hQ := gram_ineq (w := X - V) hu hn hX
  have hb := hyp_between (a := ⟪X - V, n⟫) (t := ‖X - V‖) (m := ⟪u, n⟫) hks hk hs hm1 hm2
    hd₁ (by rw [ha, hc]) (norm_nonneg _) hQ
  have hd₂k : d₂ * k < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hd₂ hk
  rw [dist_tangent_eq_abs hu hks hX hF₁ hp₁, dist_tangent_eq_abs hu hks hX hF₂ hp₂,
    abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ ‖X - V‖ - d₂ * k by linarith [norm_nonneg (X - V)]),
    abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ ‖X - V‖ - d₁ * k by linarith)]
  ring

name: Dandelin.hyp_lower
statement:
theorem hyp_lower {V u n p₀ X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫)
    (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd₂ : d₂ < 0) (hc₂ : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ = d₂ * (⟪u, n⟫ - s))
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = |d₁| * s) (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = |d₂| * s) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V (-u) k) :
    ‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k
proof:
:= by
  have := hyp_upper (u := -u) (d₁ := -d₂) (d₂ := -d₁) (F₁ := F₂) (F₂ := F₁)
    (by rw [norm_neg, hu]) hn hks hk hs (by rw [inner_neg_left]; linarith)
    (by rw [inner_neg_left]; linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by rw [inner_neg_left, hc₂]; ring) (by rw [neg_smul_neg, abs_neg]; exact hF₂)
    (by rw [neg_smul_neg]; exact hp₂) (by rw [neg_smul_neg, abs_neg]; exact hF₁)
    (by rw [neg_smul_neg]; exact hp₁) hXπ hX
  linear_combination this

name: Dandelin.hyp_converse_alg
statement:
theorem hyp_converse_alg {A B t p k d₁ d₂ e : ℝ} (hd : d₁ ≠ d₂) (he : e ^ 2 = 1)
    (hA2 : A ^ 2 = t ^ 2 - 2 * d₁ * p + d₁ ^ 2 * k ^ 2)
    (hB2 : B ^ 2 = t ^ 2 - 2 * d₂ * p + d₂ ^ 2 * k ^ 2)
    (hdiff : A - B = e * ((d₁ - d₂) * k)) : p ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (d₁ - d₂) * (-2 * p + (d₁ + d₂) * k ^ 2 - e * k * (A + B)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hB2 - hA2 + (A + B) * hdiff
  have h1 : -2 * p + (d₁ + d₂) * k ^ 2 - e * k * (A + B) = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h0 with h | h
    · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.1 h) hd
    · exact h
  have hk : e * k * A = d₁ * k ^ 2 - p := by
    linear_combination (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * h1 + (e * k / 2) * hdiff + ((d₁ - d₂) * k ^ 2 / 2) * he
  linear_combination (k ^ 2 * A ^ 2) * he + k ^ 2 * hA2 - (e * k * A + d₁ * k ^ 2 - p) * hk

name: Dandelin.hyp_converse
statement:
theorem hyp_converse {V u X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hd : d₁ ≠ d₂)
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = |d₁| * s) (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = |d₂| * s) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hdiff : |‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖| = (d₁ - d₂) * k) : X ∈ cone2 V u k
proof:
:= by
  have hA := focal_sq hu hks hF₁ hp₁
  have hB := focal_sq hu hks hF₂ hp₂
  show ⟪X - V, u⟫ ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * ‖X - V‖ ^ 2
  have h0 : 0 ≤ (d₁ - d₂) * k := hdiff ▸ abs_nonneg _
  rcases (abs_eq h0).1 hdiff with h | h
  · exact hyp_converse_alg (e := 1) hd (one_pow 2) hA hB (by rw [h]; ring)
  · exact hyp_converse_alg (e := -1) hd (by norm_num) hA hB (by rw [h]; ring)

name: Dandelin.ecc_neg
statement: theorem ecc_neg (m k : ℝ) : ecc (-m) k = ecc m k
proof: := by unfold ecc; rw [neg_sq]

name: Dandelin.axisPlane_neg
statement: theorem axisPlane_neg (V u : E) (b : ℝ) : axisPlane V (-u) (-b) = axisPlane V u b
proof:
:= by
  ext Y
  show ⟪Y - V, -u⟫ = -b ↔ ⟪Y - V, u⟫ = b
  rw [inner_neg_right, neg_inj]

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_abs
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_abs {V u n p₀ X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d * k ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ := hX
  rw [dist_tangent_eq_abs hu hks hX hF hperp, ecc, div_mul_eq_mul_div,
    ← infDist_axisPlane_eq_mul (V := V) (b := d * k ^ 2) hu hn hm hXπ, infDist_axisPlane hu,
    hX', show k * ‖X - V‖ - d * k ^ 2 = k * (‖X - V‖ - d * k) by ring, abs_mul,
    abs_of_pos hk]
  field_simp

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_lower
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_lower {V u n p₀ X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V (-u) k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d * k ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have := focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_abs (u := -u) (d := -d) (by rw [norm_neg, hu]) hn hks hk
    (by rw [inner_neg_left, neg_sq]; exact hm) hXπ hX
    (by rw [neg_smul_neg, abs_neg]; exact hF) (by rw [neg_smul_neg]; exact hperp)
  rw [inner_neg_left, ecc_neg, neg_mul] at this
  unfold directrix at this ⊢
  rwa [axisPlane_neg] at this

name: Dandelin.hyp_param_sub
statement:
theorem hyp_param_sub {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) :
    param₁ V u n p₀ s - param₂ V u n p₀ s =
      2 * s * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (s ^ 2 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ⟪u, n⟫ + s ≠ 0 := by intro h; linarith
  have h2 : ⟪u, n⟫ - s ≠ 0 := by intro h; linarith
  have h3 : s ^ 2 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have := mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hm2) (show 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ + s by linarith)
    intro h; nlinarith
  unfold param₁ param₂
  rw [div_sub_div _ _ h1 h2, div_eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero h1 h2) h3]
  ring

name: Dandelin.hyp_orient
statement:
theorem hyp_orient {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n' : E, ‖n'‖ = 1 ∧ plane p₀ n' = plane p₀ n ∧ -s < ⟪u, n'⟫ ∧ ⟪u, n'⟫ < s ∧
      0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n'⟫ ∧ (∀ C : E, |⟪C - p₀, n'⟫| = |⟪C - p₀, n⟫|)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.1 hm
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hc with h | h
  · refine ⟨-n, by rw [norm_neg, hn], plane_neg p₀ n, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [inner_neg_right]; linarith
    · rw [inner_neg_right]; linarith
    · rw [inner_neg_right]; linarith
    · intro C; rw [inner_neg_right, abs_neg]
  · exact ⟨n, hn, rfl, h1, h2, h, fun _ => rfl⟩

name: Dandelin.dandelin_hyperbola
statement:
theorem dandelin_hyperbola {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    1 < ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k ∧
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, d₂ < 0 ∧ 0 < d₁ ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = |d| * s ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      F₁ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧ F₂ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • u) - ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • u) - ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k → ‖X - F₂‖ - ‖X - F₁‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V (-u) k → ‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k ↔ |‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖| = (d₁ - d₂) * k) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k →
        ‖X - F₁‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d₁ * k ^ 2)) ∧
        ‖X - F₂‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d₂ * k ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n', hn', hpl, hm1, hm2, hc', habs⟩ := hyp_orient (V := V) (u := u) hn hm hc
  have hd₁ : 0 < param₁ V u n' p₀ s := hyp_param₁_pos hm1 hc'
  have hd₂ : param₂ V u n' p₀ s < 0 := hyp_param₂_neg hm2 hc'
  have e₁ : ⟪p₀ - V, n'⟫ = param₁ V u n' p₀ s * (⟪u, n'⟫ + s) := by
    unfold param₁; field_simp [show ⟪u, n'⟫ + s ≠ 0 by linarith]
  have e₂ : ⟪p₀ - V, n'⟫ = param₂ V u n' p₀ s * (⟪u, n'⟫ - s) := by
    unfold param₂; field_simp [show ⟪u, n'⟫ - s ≠ 0 by linarith]
  have htan : ∀ d : ℝ, |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = |d| * s ↔
      d = param₁ V u n' p₀ s ∨ d = param₂ V u n' p₀ s := fun d => by
    rw [← habs]; exact hyp_tangent_iff hs hm1 hm2 d
  have hmu : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have := mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hm) (show 0 < s + |⟪u, n⟫| by linarith [abs_nonneg ⟪u, n⟫])
    nlinarith [sq_abs ⟪u, n⟫, mul_pos hk hk]
  have hD : 0 ≤ (param₁ V u n' p₀ s - param₂ V u n' p₀ s) * k :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) hk.le
  refine ⟨(one_lt_ecc_iff hks hk hs).2 hm, param₁ V u n' p₀ s, param₂ V u n' p₀ s, _, _,
    hd₂, hd₁, htan, proj_mem_plane hn, proj_mem_plane hn, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X hX hXc
    obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inl rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inr rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    exact hyp_upper hu hn' hks hk hs hm1 hm2 hd₁ hd₂ e₁ a1 b1 a2 b2 (by rw [hpl]; exact hX) hXc
  · intro X hX hXc
    obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inl rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inr rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    exact hyp_lower hu hn' hks hk hs hm1 hm2 hd₁ hd₂ e₂ a1 b1 a2 b2 (by rw [hpl]; exact hX) hXc
  · intro X hX
    obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inl rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inr rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    have hX' : X ∈ plane p₀ n' := by rw [hpl]; exact hX
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases mem_cone2_iff.1 h with h | h
      · rw [abs_sub_comm, hyp_upper hu hn' hks hk hs hm1 hm2 hd₁ hd₂ e₁ a1 b1 a2 b2 hX' h,
          abs_of_nonneg hD]
      · rw [hyp_lower hu hn' hks hk hs hm1 hm2 hd₁ hd₂ e₂ a1 b1 a2 b2 hX' h,
          abs_of_nonneg hD]
    · intro h
      exact hyp_converse hu hks (hd₂.trans hd₁).ne' a1 b1 a2 b2 h
  · intro X hX hXc
    obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inl rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := tangent_of_proj hn rfl ((htan _).2 (Or.inr rfl)) hX (proj_mem_plane hn)
    rcases mem_cone2_iff.1 hXc with h | h
    · exact ⟨focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_abs hu hn hks hk hmu hX h a1 b1,
        focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_abs hu hn hks hk hmu hX h a2 b2⟩
    · exact ⟨focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_lower hu hn hks hk hmu hX h a1 b1,
        focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_lower hu hn hks hk hmu hX h a2 b2⟩

name: Dandelin.mem_cone_iff_angle
statement:
theorem mem_cone_iff_angle {V u X : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi)
    (hX : X ≠ V) : X ∈ cone V u (Real.cos α) ↔ angle (X - V) u = α
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 hX)
  show ⟪X - V, u⟫ = Real.cos α * ‖X - V‖ ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Real.injOn_cos ⟨angle_nonneg _ _, angle_le_pi _ _⟩ hα
    rw [cos_angle, h, hu, mul_one, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hn]
  · intro h
    have := cos_angle (X - V) u
    rw [h, hu, mul_one] at this
    rw [this, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hn]

name: Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff_angle
statement:
theorem mem_cone2_iff_angle {V u X : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi)
    (hX : X ≠ V) :
    X ∈ cone2 V u (Real.cos α) ↔ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cone2_iff, mem_cone_iff_angle hu hα hX,
    mem_cone_iff_angle (by rw [norm_neg, hu]) hα hX, angle_neg_right]
  constructor <;> rintro (h | h) <;> first | exact Or.inl h | exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: Dandelin.generator_mem_cone
statement:
theorem generator_mem_cone {V u w : E} {k t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hwu : ⟪w, u⟫ = k)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) : V + t • w ∈ cone V u k
proof:
:= by
  show ⟪V + t • w - V, u⟫ = k * ‖V + t • w - V‖
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_left, hwu, norm_smul, hw, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg ht]
  ring

name: Dandelin.exists_generator_of_mem_cone
statement:
theorem exists_generator_of_mem_cone {V u X : E} {k : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hXV : X ≠ V) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ∃ w : E, ‖w‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪w, u⟫ = k ∧ X = V + t • w
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ⟪X - V, u⟫ = k * ‖X - V‖ := hX
  have hn : 0 < ‖X - V‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 hXV)
  refine ⟨‖X - V‖, hn, ‖X - V‖⁻¹ • (X - V), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
  · rw [real_inner_smul_left, hX']
    field_simp
  · rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn.ne', one_smul, add_sub_cancel]

name: Dandelin.mem_plane_iff
statement: theorem mem_plane_iff {p₀ n X : E} : X ∈ plane p₀ n ↔ ⟪X - p₀, n⟫ = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Dandelin.plane_eq_mk'
statement:
theorem plane_eq_mk' (p₀ n : E) :
    plane p₀ n = (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  show ⟪X - p₀, n⟫ = 0 ↔ _
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, AffineSubspace.mem_mk', vsub_eq_sub,
    Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left]

name: Dandelin.tangencyPoint_mem_line
statement:
theorem tangencyPoint_mem_line (V X : E) (k d : ℝ) :
    tangencyPoint V X k d ∈ line[ℝ, V, X]
proof:
:= by
  have : tangencyPoint V X k d = AffineMap.lineMap V X (d * k / ‖X - V‖) := by
    rw [tangencyPoint, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module', add_comm]
  rw [this]
  exact AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _

name: Dandelin.isTangentAt_tangencyPoint
statement:
